You will get two pieces from the sign, and after gathering the other two from the [Glowing Grove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72349), you automatically create the quest item Campground Banner to progress the quest.

**Related Quest:** [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677)

Locations.Title: Campground Banner
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Obtained automatically after picking up the four Banner Pieces for [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612) side quest [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677). The banner progresses the quest by revealing that the next place to investigate is the unmarked Kawaketak Station.

**Related Quest:** [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677)

Locations.Title: Power Tools
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found near the steamer trunk in the basement of [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334) during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Hall Breach](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516663). 

After the power tools are retrieved, the scavenger Machete Mike will appear outside the tannery and offer to buy them. Selling the tools to him instead of returning them to The Mariner will complete the quest, but it will prevent access to the follow-up side quests [Hull Breach 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516664) and [Hull Breach 3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516669).

**Related Quest:** [Hall Breach](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516663)

Locations.Title: Brain Dead

_There has been a murder in Vault 118. I may want to investigate._

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: Brain Dead, Part 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:

**Quest Giver:** Ezra Parker

**Rewards:**

Locations.Title: Shipbreaker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Trigger a random event that adds Shipbreaker's Radio Frequency to your Pip-Boy

**Quest Giver:** Shipbreaker's Radio Frequency / [Old Longfellow](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=351101)

_Old Longfellow has been tracking an ancient Fog Crawler known as "Shipbreaker" for years, but has never caught her yet. I can track her using my Pip-Boy radio when she's nearby._

- XP

Locations.Title: The Price of Memory
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:

**Quest Giver:** Cog

_Cog is concerned about Jule's mental state, and has asked that I speak with her._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Unyielding Synth Chest Piece](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=515031) (if you tell Jules about her past)

Locations.Title: Data Recovery
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to DiMA for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Faraday

_Faraday has asked me to recover some missing storage drives that could be used to help DiMA. They're on a boat to the southwest of Acadia._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Acadian Ideals
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to DiMA for the first time

**Quest Giver:** DiMA

_DiMA, the leader of Acadia, has opened the compound to me. He mentioned that if I want to help, I can work with his co-founders, Faraday and Chase._

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: The Arrival
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to DiMA for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Chase

_Chase is concerned about a synth who was supposed to arrive at Acadia, but hasn't shown up yet. She sent me to Far Harbor to ask Brooks if he's seen the missing synth._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Hitman's Overcharged Institute Rifle [Cell]](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72718)

Locations.Title: Hunting the Hunter
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [The Arrival](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516658) and Commonwealth main quest [Hunter/Hunted](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=354344)

**Quest Giver:** Dejen

_Dejen has asked me to investigate reports of a Courser tracking Acadia's location. If I can find him, I need to eliminate him._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Dejen's inventory is 20% cheaper

Locations.Title: Blood Tide
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Cassie Dalton

_A woman named Cassie Dalton asked me to help her avenge some deaths in her family. She wants me to kill the Feral Ghouls in National Park Campground who are responsible for the death of her cousin._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Bloodletter [Pole Hook]](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72701)
- [Dalton Farm Workbench](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403113)

Locations.Title: Living on the Edge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** Captain Avery

_The citizens of Far Harbor are in desperate need of help._

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: Safe Passage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to DiMA for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Captain Avery

_Captain Avery in Far Harbor is concerned because the Fog Condensers that protect the road to a nearby water purifier aren't working. She asked me to find Howard Dunbar, who she sent out to make the repairs._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Hull Breach
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Quest Giver:** The Mariner

_In order to reinforce Far Harbor's wall ("the Hull") the Mariner needs special power tools. I've agreed to go to Eagle's Cove Tannery and collect them._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- Combat Shotgun (If you passed a speech check at the start of the quest)
- 2000 Caps (if you give the tools to Machete Mike)
- 2750 Caps (if you pass a speech check, then give the tools to Machete Mike)

Locations.Title: Hull Breach 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Rite of Passage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516665) and [Hull Breach](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516663) by returning the tools to The Mariner

**Quest Giver:** The Mariner

_The Mariner plans on reinforcing Far Harbor's walls with part of a ship's hull. In order to do this, I have to clear out the trappers at the MS Azalea._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps

Locations.Title: Rite of Passage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Living on the Edge](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516661)

**Quest Giver:** Teddy Wright

_In order to do the "Captain's Dance," I need to go to Emmet's Causeway and drop fresh meat in the water to whip the local wildlife into a frenzy._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [The Captain's Hat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516666)
- The Captain's Feast consumable (+10% XP for 2 in-game hours when eaten)

Locations.Title: The Changing Tide
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Living on the Edge](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516661)

**Quest Giver:** Teddy Wright

_After completing the Captain's Dance, I've earned the town's respect. Far Harbor still faces many challenges and could use my help._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Rescue Diver Suit

Locations.Title: Hull Breach 3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Hull Breach 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516664)

**Quest Giver:** The Mariner

_In the Mariner's continuing effort to overly-reinforce Far Harbor, she wants three mirelurk carapaces. Any of the shelled mirelurks on this island have the carapaces I need._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Defender's Harpoon Gun [Harpoon]](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72707)

Locations.Title: The Great Hunt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Hull Breach 3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516669)

**Quest Giver:** The Mariner

_I've agreed to hunt a mythical beast with the Mariner: the Red Death. I need to take my boat and travel with the Mariner to where she hopes to find it._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Legend of the Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516671)

Locations.Title: The Hold Out
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Rite of Passage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516665)

**Quest Giver:** Mitch (inside The Last Plank where you met [Old Longfellow](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=351101))

_I've accepted a job from Mitch to find his uncle at the National Park Visitor's Center. He's the only person still living on the interior of the island and may be in danger._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Fire Belly Recipe](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516674)
- [National Park Workbench](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403114)

Locations.Title: Turn Back the Fog
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Rite of Passage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516665)

**Quest Giver:** Small Bertha

_Small Bertha wants to find a new home for some of the derelicts in Far Harbor. She needs me to clear out any threats at Echo Lake Lumber Mill._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Echo Lake Lumber Workbench](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403115)

Locations.Title: Ablutions
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to Tektus for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Sister Mai

_Sister Mai asked me to recover an industrial-strength pump regulator from the Vim! Pop factory. The place is apparently crawling with Super Mutants, so I'll need to be cautious._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- Caps
- [Radical Conversion [.45]](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72706)

Locations.Title: The Heretic
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to Tektus for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Grand Zealot Richter

_Grand Zealot Richter told me to track down Sister Gwyneth, a former Child of Atom turned heretic. I should talk to Zealot Theil, who might know how to find her._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Atom's Judgement [Super Sledge]](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72699)

Locations.Title: What Atom Requires
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to Tektus for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Grand Zealot Richter

_I've joined the Children of Atom. If I want to really earn a place for myself in this family, it'd probably be worth asking around to see if anyone could use my help._

**Rewards:**
- XP

Locations.Title: The Trial of Brother Devin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Speak to Tektus for the first time

**Quest Giver:** Zealot Ware

_Zealot Ware asked me to speak to Brother Devin and convince him to end his fast._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Ware's Brew Recipe](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516681)

Locations.Title: Witch Hunt
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Talk to Tektus for the first time and ask if there's anything he needs done.

**Quest Giver:** High Confessor Tektus

_The High Confessor's tasked me with investigating a member of the Children. I need to check his note to see who I'm looking into._

**Rewards:**
- XP
- [Inquisitor's Cowl](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516683)

Locations.Title: Wind Farm Maintenance
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by two Assaultrons and five Turrets.

Located east of [Acadia](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72615), the location is tied to the main quest [Cleansing the Land](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444040) if you side with Acadia or the Nucleus against Far Harbor. A secured door cannot be opened until power is restored to its button. 

You must find four industrial-grade fuses for the fuse box at the end of the red wire leading from the door. One fuse is next to the fuse box, while the other three are on shelving across the hall along with a tool case. A steamer trunk can be found behind the Turbine 003 Regulator Terminal.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Industrial-Grade Fuse x4](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=593960)
- Gum Drop (Next to Turbine 003 Regulator Terminal)
- Cram (In a blue plastic bin in the hallway leading to a terminal)

Locations.Title: Kitterredge Pass
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Ghouls, with a single turret outside.

The tunnel was previously controlled by Trappers, but Ghouls have since taken over, with dead Trappers throughout. The tunnel comes out at an [unmarked entrance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566723) west of Kitteredge Pass.

**Notable Loot:**
- Machete (Beside a mining cart)
- Hardened Sniper Rifle (On top of a mining cart)
- Gas Mask (On a red chair)
- Psycho Jet (Near a pile of human bones)
- Jet (On a table beside a mattress)
- Med-X (On top of a burning barrel)
- Whiskey (Near a pile of human bones)
- Gwinnett Ale x2 (In a plastic bin beside a red chair)

Locations.Title: Pine Crest Cavern
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

The cavern ends at a door leading into the interior of [Kitterredge Pass](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72337) to the north. After landing in a pool of water, you can either continue to the entrance of Kitterredge Pass or go left to reach the pass's [unmarked exit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566723).

**Notable Loot:**
- Machete (On a table, with a duffle bag beneath it)
- Welding Goggles (On a barrel on the upper level of the cavern)
- Buffjet (On a barrel on the upper level of the cavern)
- Whiskey x2 (Beside the steamer trunk & on a shelf outside the cavern)

Locations.Title: Ruined Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied**

During [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612) side quest [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677), Sister Gwyneth, a heretical member of the Children of Atom, is found here.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Overdue Book x2**: Behind the lectern and atop the steeple.
- **Hardened Sniper Rifle**: Atop the church steeple.
- **Buffout**: On a second-floor desk.
- **Sweet Roll**: Beside a skeleton in the graveyard.
- **Prosnap Camera**: Beside a skeleton in the graveyard.
- **Blue Paint**: On scaffolding on the first floor.
- **Yellow Paint**: On scaffolding on the first floor.
- **Teddy Bear**: In a bear trap on the second floor.

Locations.Title: Beaver Creek Lanes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

**Notable Items:**
- [Mark Wilson's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437540)
- [Modified Bowling Ball Schematic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=564072)
- [The Striker](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72691)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=117092)
- Day Tripper (Sink in the men's washroom)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (Next to front desk terminal)
- Vim x2 (Dining hall by a green sign & near the fusion core.)

Locations.Title: Eden Meadows Cinemas
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

The drive-in theater has two movies: the western Last Stand at Fort McGee on the southern screen, and the horror movie Night of the Fish Men’s Revenge on the northern screen. Only one movie can play at a time, and the feral ghouls will gather around whichever screen is active.  

The films can be switched using the circuit breakers at the top of each projection tower. Activating one projector switches to its corresponding movie and turns off the other. The western projector controls Night of the Fish Men’s Revenge, while the eastern projector controls Last Stand at Fort McGee.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Manager's Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591679)
- [Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591676)
- [Nuka-Cherry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591675)
- Vault-Tech Lunchbox (Top of the eastern projection tower, by a skeleton)
- Giddyup Buttercup (The intact toy is in the restrooms)

Locations.Title: Oceanarium
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

This is a trapper outpost with no specific side quests or main quests connected to it, aside from being randomly selected for a radiant quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- Fisherman's Hat (Worn by a mannequin)
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (Inside the trailer)
- Fishing Rod x3 (Trailer, held by a mannequin, & on a building's floor)

Locations.Title: Rayburn Point
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Trappers.**

This is a trapper outpost with no specific side quests or main quests connected to it, aside from being randomly selected for a radiant quest. There are several containers to loot, including wall safes on the first and second floors of the main building.  

**Notable Loot:** 
- **Whiskey**: On a lounger on back deck of the mail building.
- **Aluminum Can**: Beside the sleeping bag in the main building.
- **Teddy Bear (Large-Size)**: Beside the sleeping bag in the main building.

Locations.Title: Eagle's Cove Tannery
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

The tannery is involved in the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Hall Breach](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516663), which requires retrieving a bag of power tools from the basement of the tannery. Upon leaving the tannery’s interior, a scavenger named Machete Mike will approach and offer to buy the tools. Accepting his offer causes the quest to fail and locks off the rest of the “Hull Breach” quest chain.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Tanner Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591677)
- [Power Tools](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591678)
- Hide Bundle x15 (Twelve are located on an exterior conveyor belt)
- Combat Shotgun (On top of a open safe in the locked room)

Locations.Title: Echo Lake Lumber
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

It can become a settlement during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Turn Back the Fog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516675), which involves clearing out the feral ghouls.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Levi's Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357145)
- [The Harvester](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72696)
- Vim Captain's Blend (Vim machine near a concession stand)
- Vim x2 (Grandstands near the cash register, & Vim machine)
- Coffee Tin x2 (In the concession stand with the espresso machine)
- Oil Canister (On the second floor shelving in the main building)
- Gas Canister (On the second floor shelving in the main building)
- Aluminium Cannister x2 (On a pickup and on second floor shelving)
- Flip Lighter x2 (On a desk on the second floor)
- Mr. Handy Fuel (On the third floor beside a ammo box)
- Office Desk Fan (On the fourth floor beside the terminal)
- Aluminium Can x6

Locations.Title: Vim! Pop Factory
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

The basement area is reached by taking an elevator located in the mixing area of the factory. Within the basement, there is a door to a medical facility that can only be opened by speaking to an AI program called KYE 1.1. The door can be unlocked either by passing a speech check or by bringing [Nick Valentine](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=351089) as a companion.

**Notable Loot:**

Exterior
- [Vim Recipes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=569862)
- Vim Captain's Blend (Near the R&D Terminal on the roof)

Corporate Headquarters
- [Vim CEO Password](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357148)
- Vim (Oversized Bottle)

- Vim x7
- Vim Captain's Blend x3 (Break Room, Madison's Desk, & CEO Office)
- Vim Quartz (In front of the gift shop)
- Vim Refresh x2 (Gift shop & break room fridge)

Factory
- Vim! Paint Schematics
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72711)

- Pump Regulator for [Ablutions](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516676).
- Vim x5
- Vim Captain's Blend x2 (Bottling area & taste testing area)
- Vim Quartz x2 (Shipping area & taste testing area)

Basement
- [What's Done is Done](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357149)

- Avery's Locket (Unmarked grave) during [What's Done is Done](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357149).
- Avery's Skull (Unmarked grave) during  [What's Done is Done](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357149).

Locations.Title: Dalton Farm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a [Fog Crawler](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=592163).

The farm becomes a settlement during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Blood Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516660), given by Cassie Dalton, which requires eliminating a Fog Crawler at the farm. 

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island Bog
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulper and Feral Ghouls.

In a blue shipping contain, there is a door to the Gibbons family bunker that cannot be opened until three power generators on Cranberry Island are repaired and their circuit breaker switched on. 

**The three generator are as follows:** 
- [Power Generator 1](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567209#L)
- [Power Generator 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567202#L)
- [Power Generator 3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567203#L)

**Notable Loot:**
- [Eliza Family Drawing](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567207)
- [Damaged Hazmat Suit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567208)
- Vim (Next to a blue scale in a shed)

Locations.Title: Glowing Grove
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, but patrolling wolves nearby.

The bulletin board called the “Heretical Sign” can be interacted with during [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612) side quest [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677), granting two banner pieces for the quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Banner Piece x2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590345)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357151)

Locations.Title: Huntress Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Yao Guai, Wolves, Radstag, Mirelurks, and a Angler.

The island has four buildings, burning boats just off its north coast, a public beach, a small island to its south with a shed, and a skerry to its southwest, where a lighthouse can be seen just beyond the game’s playable area.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Love Letter to Bridget](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566716)
- Nuka-Cherry
- Overdue Book (Bench on small island to the south)
- Sea Captain's Hat (Public Beach on the eastside of the island)

Locations.Title: Harbor Grand Hotel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

There is a secret safe room in a bedroom, accessed through a hole in the kitchen pantry. The keypad by the room’s shelf will only work once you have the code at the start of the main quest [Cleansing the Land](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444040). 

[Safe Room Security Tape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=145071) from the terminal in the safe room helps you find what you need if you plan to go against the Nucleus during the quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Drain Corpse Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566148)
- [Ship's Safe Combination](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566149)
- [Safe Room Security Tape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=145071)
- [To Franny](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=145070)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (Drawer in second floor hallway)
- Vim x2 (In the a kitchen fridge & on the dresser near the safe room.)
- Daddy-O (Picnic table along the hotel’s boardwalk)
- Machete (Beside the dead mongrel in the kitchen)
- Chef Hat (On a shelf in the kitchen)

Locations.Title: Aldersea Day Spa
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

This is a super mutant stronghold with no specific side quests or main quests connected to it, aside from being randomly selected for a radiant quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Aldersea Day Spa Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=592166)
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=592165)
- Med-X (Near the safe in the advanced-lock room)
- Machete (Bloody countertop near the reception desk)
- Bathrobe x2 (Massage Rooms)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (Under a bench near the pool)
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (On a table beside the pool)
- Oil x2 (Massage Rooms)

Locations.Title: Far Harbor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
At the end of Far Harbor’s pier sits the town’s watering hole, [The Last Plank](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563613), an unmarked location. You arrive at Far Harbor during the opening main quest of the Far Harbor DLC, [Far From Home](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=403116), which begins in the Commonwealth.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Old Letter](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563620)
- [Report from PV](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563621)
- [Consultation Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563622)
- [Last Note from Mom](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563623)
- [Recon Marine Helmet](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=510951) sold by [Brooks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563625)
- [The Fish Catcher](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72702) sold by [Allen Lee](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563624)
- [Admiral's Friend](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72700) sold by [Allen Lee](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563624)
- [Bloodletter](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72701) from [Blood Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516660)

- [Rescue Diver Suit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516668) from [The Changing Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516667)
- [Defender's Harpoon Gun](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72707) from [Hull Breach 3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516669)
- [Legend of the Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516671) from [The Great Hunt](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516670)
- [Lucky Eddy](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72703) from [The Way Life Should Be](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403120) if DiMA's secret revealed.

Locations.Title: National Park Visitor's Center
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

The location becomes a settlement after speaking to Uncle Ken during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [The Hold Out](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516673), given by [Mitch](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563644) inside [The Last Plank](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563613).

**Notable Loot:**
- [The Islander's Almanac](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72713)

Locations.Title: Horizon Flight 1207
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The plane is the home of [Erickson](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563661), an intelligent super mutant who serves as a trader and sells guard dogs for your settlements. He initially offers [Duke](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563665), a Rottweiler; [Mishka](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563664), a wolf; and [Gracie](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563668), a mutant hound. Once purchased, they are later replaced by random dogs available for sale.

The cockpit of the plane contains a steamer trunk but is sealed off by a security door. It can be opened using a nearby terminal with Advanced-level encryption.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Butcher's Hook](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72698)
- [Super Mutant Bearskin Outfit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563662)
- [Duke](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563665)
- [Mishka](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563664)
- [Gracie](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563668)

Locations.Title: Radiant Crest Shrine
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

The bulletin board called the “Heretical Sign” can be interacted with during [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612) side quest [The Heretic](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516677), granting two banner pieces for the quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Banner Piece x2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590346)
- [Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357144)

Locations.Title: Haddock Cove
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

A former fishing settlement now occupied by mirelurks, which killed its previous residents. The bodies of Luke, Braun, Rowan, and their leader, Bray Husky, can be found throughout the settlement. Several containers can also be looted, including a military-style trunk inside a central shack.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437546)**
- **[Chores List Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357142)**
- **[Husky Family Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357141)**
- **[Family Announcement](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357140)**
- **Recon Powerful Sniper Rifle**: On a chair on top of the tower.
- **Combat Knife**: Held by a garden gnome on top of the tower.
- **Whiskey**: On a crate beside a red chair.
- **Gwinnett Lager**: On a bed in the tower.
- **Purified Water**: On a picnic table and a barbecue.
- **Corn x3**: On a barbecue.
- **Cram**: On a picnic table with a radio.
- **Moldy Food**: On a crate beside a barbecue.
- **Garden Gnome**: On top of the tower.

Locations.Title: DiMA's Cache
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

The island itself has only a ammo box to loot. However, during the main quest [Best Left Forgotten](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403119) a patch of dirt labelled "Disturbed Earth" can be interacted with to reveal a tool case called uncovered case containing the [Wind Turbine Code](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=575434). 

This island remains unmarked on your map until the quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Wind Turbine Code](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=575434)**
- **Blight x3**: Available to harvest from the island's trees.

Locations.Title: Brooke's Head Lighthouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers

There is a terminal with advanced encryption near top of the stairs leading to the beach south of the lighthouse. It can turn off the turret and spotlight facing the beach.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Islander's Almanac](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72716)
- [Mysterious Holotape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357152)
- [Douglas's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=569226)
- [Douglas's Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=569227)
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72709)
- Vim Captain's Blend (On east roof steeple of the manor)
- Undamaged Baseball Glove (Manor first floor, on side table)
- Undamaged Camera (Manor second floor, in bedroom)

Locations.Title: Rock Point Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Trappers.**

The camp is a trapper outpost with no related quests or notable items, though you can find a steamer trunk in a rowboat, along with other lootable containers.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Dirty Water**: On the kitchen counter inside the house.
- **Salisbury Steak**: In the fridge inside the house.
- **Pork N' Beans**: In the fridge inside the house.

Locations.Title: Fringe Cove Docks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurks and Gulpers.

A dilapidated pre-war dock. There are two duffel bags in the tugboat, containing about 80+ pre-War money. There’s also a sleeping bag with mannequins inside a red shipping container on the barge at the docks.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fringe Cove Dock Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=570205)
- [Nuclear Launch Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=570204)
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=570203)
- Vault-Tech Lunchbox (Row boat - southeast building)

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island Docks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Inside the run aground tugboat, you can find two safes on the lower deck: one with a novice lock and one with an expert lock.

**Notable Loot:**
- Vim Quartz (On second floor of eastern warehouse)

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island Supply Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurks.

The shed's door cannot be opened without the Cranberry Island Shed Key found within the bunker at [Cranberry Island Bog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72607). The Shed contains a steamer trunk, along with a number of material listed below.

**Notable Loot:**
- Within Shed: Acid x7, Aluminum x18, Antiseptic x10, Asbestos x14, Bag of Cement x17, Ballistic Fiber x10, Cloth x19, Cork x7, Duct Tape x15, Fertilizer x6, Fiber Optics x9, Fiberglass x9, Gears x12, Lead x1, Leather x18, Oil Can x14, Rubber x7, Screw x32, Spring x15, & Steel x20

Locations.Title: Super Duper Mart
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers. 

West of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) there is a chemistry station and a cooking station along with three sleeping bags. In addition there is a ammo box, first aid container, and a suitcase along the side of the building along with an explosives crate on the roof. 

**Notable Loot**
- None

Locations.Title: Red Death Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the island has several ships wrecked along its shore. A dead trader can be found on a sailboat, while a blue fishing boat contains a cooler, an explosives box, and two ammunition boxes. A red steamer trunk is partially buried along the island’s coast.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Coolant Cap**: On board the white boat wreck.
- **Gas Canister**: On board the white boat wreck.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: On board the white boat wreck.
- **Radstag Hide**: Beside the dead trader on the sailboat.
- **Aster x5**: Can be harvested beside a log on the isle’s coast.

Locations.Title: Bunker
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located on the island east of [Echo Lake Lumber](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72346), the bunker’s entrance is found beneath what appears to be an H formed by a fallen tree between two others. Inside, there is a first aid kit, an ammo box, a cooler, a duffle bag, a desk, and a master-locked safe to loot, along with a chemistry station and a bed.

**Notable Loot:**
- Daddy-O x2 (On the desk)
- Kitchen Scale (On the desk)
- Pre-War Money x2 (On the desk)

Locations.Title: Southeastern Tugboat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located east of the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361), you can find a Seal Shipment container holding the left and right arm pieces of the Marine Armor set during a miscellaneous quest received in the main quest [Best Left Forgotten](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403119), after retrieving DiMA’s fifth memory. 

The remaining pieces of the Marine Armor set can be found at two other locations off the coast of the island: the [Southwestern Tugboat Wreck](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484232) southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), and the [Yellow Shipping Container](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484233) southwest of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348).

**Notable Loot:**
- [Assault Marine Armor Left and Right Arm](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=565932)

Locations.Title: Southwestern Tugboat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), you can find a Sealed Shipment container holding the left and right leg pieces of the Marine Armor set during a miscellaneous quest received in the main quest [Best Left Forgotten](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403119), after retrieving DiMA’s fifth memory. 

The remaining pieces of the Marine Armor set can be found at two other locations off the coast of the island: the [Southeastern Tugboat Wreck](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484231) east of the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361), and the [Yellow Shipping Container](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484233) southwest of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348).

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Assault Marine Armor Left and Right Leg](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=565931)**

Locations.Title: Yellow Shipping Container
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southwest of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), you can find a Seal Shipment container holding the helmet and chest piece of the Marine Armor set, along with the Marine Tactical Helmet and Marine Wetsuit during a miscellaneous quest received in the main quest [Best Left Forgotten](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403119), after retrieving DiMA’s fifth memory. 

The remaining pieces of the Marine Armor set can be found at two other locations off the coast of the island: the [Southeastern Sunken Tugboat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484231) east of [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361), and the [Southwestern Tugboat Wreck](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484232) southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353).

**Notable Loot:**
- [Assault Marine Armor Head & Chest](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=565930)
- [Marine Tactical Helmet](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=565928)
- [Marine Wetsuit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=565929)

Locations.Title: Mannequin Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), where the map shows an island, there is instead a sunken tugboat filled with mannequins. Inside the ship, you can loot a wooden crate, ammo box, three coolers, and a first aid kit.  

*Careful not to look the mannequins in the eye... just kidding. Maybe...*

**Notable Loot:**
- **[These Mannequins!](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514340)**
- **Gold Bar x2**: Inside a coffin within a yellow shipping container.
- **Whiskey**: Next to a skeleton on the bridge deck.
- **Board**: Held by a mannequin on the bridge deck.

Locations.Title: Ghost Sailboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), where the map shows a small island, there sits a small wooden sailboat with two skeletal occupants. Onboard, you can loot a first aid kit and meat hook. Directly underneath is a sunken white ship split in two, with a suitcase and two wooden crates to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Meat Hook**: On board the sailboat.

Locations.Title: Fishing Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Angler.**

Located west of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the shack is the lone structure on the island. It appears to have been the site of a failed last stand, with a skeleton holding a Molotov cocktail next to two explosives boxes, and a patrolling Angler as the victor. Beyond the crates, there are also a small number of items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Molotov Cocktail** Held by a skeleton. 
- **Whisky**: On top of a crate. 
- **Blowtorch**: On top of a crate.
- **Aluminum Can**: On top of crate.

Locations.Title: Basement Armory
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, but the gas station has Feral Ghouls.**

Located southeast of the [Radiant Crest Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72350), behind the gas station, the armory’s entrance doors are secured with a novice lock. Inside, there is a chemistry station and a weapons workbench, along with an explosives box and ammo box to loot. 

There is also Copland’s Terminal, which provides lore about Nuka-Cola’s plot against Vim! Pop.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Vim Captain's Blend x2** (Chemistry station & near the terminal)
- **Missile Launcher** (On table)
- **Submachine Gun** (On table)
- **Missile x2**  (On table)

Locations.Title: Fishing Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by two random hostile enemy groups.**

Located west of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the camp has fishing nets about, with an explosives box and a toolbox to loot, along with a few scattered items and a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mentats**: On top of a table.
- **Fishing Rod**: Beside the lobster traps.
- **Cooking Oil**: Below a sap bucket.
- **Raw Sap**: Found in three sap buckets around the camp.

Locations.Title: Wrecked House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Feral Ghouls and a random group of hostiles.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the house has an ammo box, toolbox, cooler, duffle bag, and suitcase to loot, plus another cooler on the dock behind the house. There are also two chairs and couches you can sit on to wait, but no bed to sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Radaway x2**: On a shelf in the kitchen.
- **Mentats x2**: On a shelf in the kitchen.
- **Bourbon**: On a small table beside a couch. 
- **Pork N' Beans x3**: On a shelf in the kitchen.
- **Potato Crisps x2**: On a shelf in the kitchen.
- **Instamash**: Beside the kitchen fridge.
- **Sweet Roll**: On the kitchen table.
- **Fishing Rod**: On the small dock next to the house.

Locations.Title: Fractured House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the house has fractured in two, with a mirelurk ready to emerge and attack if entered. Inside, there’s an unlocked safe underwater and an advanced-locked safe in the sand, plus a suitcase floating nearby.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mirelurk Eggs**: Inside the house.
- **Mr. Handy Fuel**: Floating beside a crate with a lantern. 
- **Gas Cannister**: On the small dock next to the house.
- **Fishing Rod**: On the small dock next to the house.

Locations.Title: Pump Control
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located in a culvert beside a Vim! Pop trailer southwest of [Echo Lake Lumber](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72346), the door to the pump control station cannot be opened until DiMA gives you the [Worn Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571990) to unlock it, during the main story quest [Reformation](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444044). 

Beware of fragmentation mines on the road above the culvert. 

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Sister Gwyneth's Visit](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514250)**
- **[A New Path](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514249)**
- **[What Atom Requires](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357147)**
- **[An Execution](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437537)**
- **[Mother Icon](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571991)**

Locations.Title: The Last Plank
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The watering hole of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324), located at the end of the town's pier.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Islander's Almanac](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72712)
- [RUN!](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563614)
- [Note (from Debby 1)](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563615)
- [Note (from Debby 2)](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563616)
- [Note (from Mitch 1)](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563617)
- [Note (from Mitch 2)](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563618)
- [Hunter's Long Coat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563619) worn by [Old Longfellow](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=351101)
- [Fire Belly Recipe](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516674) from [The Hold Out](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516673)
- Vim Quartz (on top of the note [RUN!](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563614) behind the counter)

Locations.Title: Ruined Seafood Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

A little west of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) there is a duffle bag and a first aid container inside along with a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Ruined Church
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Southwest of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) it has a safe with an advanced lock along with a cooler on the second floor and a large toolbox on your way up the stairs to the second floor.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Ruined Home Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) there is a steamer trunk and a first aid container in the remains of the home.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Garden Gnome Sailboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) by the Ruined Home Island there is a Garden Gnome, Skull, Machete, and a first aid container on the small boat.

**Notable Loot:**
- Garden Gnome (Back of the Sailboat)
- Machete (Beside the Garden Gnome)
- Human Skull (Beside the Garden Gnome)

Locations.Title: Maritime Museum
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Feral Ghouls**

Southwest of [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), there’s a building with a locked safe (advanced lock) and three cannonballs. Near the dry-docked boat, you’ll find an wooden crate with an ammo box inside, and there’s also a steamer trunk sitting on the small pier.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Coast Guard Hat** (Inside the ruined building)
- **Sea Captain Hat** (On wheel of dry docked boat)

Locations.Title: Abandoned Trailer Park
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, but an Angler is in the pond next to the trailer park.

Southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326) one can find an ice cooler on a picnic table, a news stand and cooler by the lone building, a suitcase to loot from the Lobster Grill Family Restaurant food truck, and a footlocker in the trailer hitched to a truck.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=564836)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (In the oven of a trailer)
- Psycho (Under a table in the store)
- Mr. Handy Fuel (In a corner of a trailer)
- Dog Food x2 (Both on a table in the store)

Locations.Title: Ruined Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326) and near the Abandoned Trailer Park, only partially accessible with little of note except for a caps of stash on the first floor, and if you perform a tricky jump, a lamp and camera on the second floor.

**Notable Loot:**
- Prosnap Camera (On the second floor)

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by wolves.

Southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326) there is not much of note, just a first aid container in the bus out front, plus a cash register and a cigarette machine inside.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gas Canister (In the station's garage)
- TV Dinner Tray x2 (On a shelf and a counter)
- Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese x2 (On a shelf)
- Potato Crisps (On a shelf)

Locations.Title: Abandoned Hunter's House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326) and next to the nearby Ruined Home. There is a cooking station and a bed on the first floor, along with a suspended carcass of a radstag doe next to a human skull used as a candle, but it cannot be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Anchor Gravestone
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, but you may be attacked by ghouls from the nearby house. 

Located north of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610), the gravestone has nothing of interest except for the macabre addition of human bones.

**Notable Loot:**
- Human Bones

Locations.Title: Ghoul House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located north of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610), there is a chem box on the first floor, a wall safe with an expert level lock on the second floor, and to access the third floor you can use a fallen tree against the house to find a steamer trunk. There is also a small shack down a rocky path on the shore, but it only has a skeleton with a shovel.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Derelict Dock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located north of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610) along the coast, there is nothing in the two submerged boats on the pier and only minor junk on the dock.

**Notable Loot:**
- Overdue Book (Beside the lantern, just north of the dock)
- Lantern (At the end of the dock)
- Cutting Fluid (At the end of the dock)

Locations.Title: Beehive Lagoon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Anglers and Mirelurks.

Located northwest of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610), the lagoon is rich in harvestable lure weed and mirelurk egg clusters. At its northern tip, a dead trapper lies near an ammo box and a Novice-locked toolbox.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this body of water, so the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- Mirelurk Eggs
- Lure Weed

Locations.Title: Shark Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

South of MS Azalea, the island is shaped like a shark and has a empty wooden crate found by three wooden poles, with a whale skeleton nearby.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Red Fishing Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located just south of Far Harbor along the east coast, the boat contains a steamer trunk, a cabinet, and a bed.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gas Canister (Beside the boat's controls)
- Instamash (Rear of the boat)
- Pork N' Beans (Rear of the boat)
- Salisbury Steak (Rear of the boat)

Locations.Title: Trapper Skerry Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Sitting off the eastern coast, just west of the Abandoned Trailer Park, the camp is setup along several boats stuck on the skerry. There’s an ammo box on the sailboat, a first aid container next to a dead trapper on the northern boat, and another dead trapper lying by an ammo box on the southern one.

**Notable Loot:**
- Short Lever Action Rifle (Held by the skeleton in the sailboat)

Locations.Title: Public Beach
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurk.

Located west of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610), the beach has a trash bin, lunch pail, cash register, and an explosive crate inside an outhouse secured with a novice lock to loot. Under the cash register in the shop, you will find six unarmed fragmentation mines stacked together.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=593976)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (On a picnic table)
- Fragmentation Mine x6 (Under the cash register)

Locations.Title: Trapper Checkpoint
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers

Located on the road heading northeast from the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361), the checkpoint has a duffle bag on the ground floor, a chem box and an ammo box on the second floor, another ammo box on the roof, and an explosives box in a culvert beneath the checkpoint. The green trailer the structure is built around is secured with an expert lock, but it can be opened using the trailer key found by the chem box.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Trailer Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566133)

Locations.Title: Trapper Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located southeast of the [Wind Farm Maintenance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72619), the outpost has an ammo box on the first floor and an explosive box with a novice lock on the second floor.

**Notable Loot:**
- Overdue Book x2 (On shelf with ammo box)
- Lantern (On the second floor of the outpost)

Locations.Title: Trapper Hobby Farm
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located southeast of the [Wind Farm Maintenance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72619), the house contains an industrial trunk with an advanced lock on the third floor, accessed via a ramp at the back. A chem box is located in the shed. A dead trapper lies on top of a usable mattress beside a cooler. In another greenhouse, there is an ammo box secured with a novice lock.

**Notable Loot:**
- Jet (On a table on the second floor)

Locations.Title: Yao Guai Den
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Yao Guai.

Located northeast of the [Wind Farm Maintenance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72619), the cave contains both animal and human bones.

**Notable Loot:**
- Human Bones

Locations.Title: Polluted Lake
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by wolves.

Located northeast of the [Wind Farm Maintenance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72619), the lake contains three broken water purification pumps and is heavily contaminated. Various barrels, including radioactive ones, are scattered in and around the water. Several Suprathaw Antifreeze and Oil Canisters can be seen floating on the surface. A toolbox can be found inside a wrecked trailer along the road nearby, where wolves are encountered.

**Notable Loot:**
- Suprathaw Antifreeze x3
- Oil Canisters x3

Locations.Title: Sunken Vertibird
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610), the Sunken Vertibird lies beyond the playable area of the map and is therefore inaccessible. It contains a set of T-51 Power Armor, with four fusion cores scattered nearby, as well as a cooler, duffel bag, ammo box, and a first aid kit. However, all of these items remain outside the map’s boundaries.

**Notable Loot (***inaccessible without mods or the tcl console command***):**
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566140)
- [Fusion Core x4](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566142)

Locations.Title: Sunken Yacht
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located east of the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361), a tool case can be found on the western side of the wreck.

**Notable Loot:**
- Harpoon Gun (Laying on the deck of the yacht)

Locations.Title: Burning Tugboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located along the coastline between Southwest Harbor and the Harbor Grand Hotel, the ship has a metal box on the upper deck, and a fusion core can be found on the main level.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357137)
- Aluminum Can (Next to the tugboat's controls)

Locations.Title: Red Manor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located along the road between Southwest Harbor and the Harbor Grand Hotel, the manor with lion statues out front contains various household items to loot, along with a dresser, bureau, chem box, and a mattress to sleep on. On the white boat moored at the dock behind the manor, there’s also a first aid kit.

**Notable Loot:**
- Flip Lighter (A table on the second floor)
- Gold Plated Flip Lighter (On a dresser on the second floor)
- Alarm Clock (On a dresser on the second floor)
- Typewriter (On a dresser on the first floor)

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, but Wolves on the road near it.

Located along the road between Southwest Harbor and the Harbor Grand Hotel. You can find a wall safe with an advance lock behind the cash register with first aid container under the counter, along with a trash can, cigarette machine, news stand, and a wooden crate in the trailer out front. With numerous junk to loot on the station's shelves.

**Notable Loot:**
- Toy Rocketship (On one of the station's shelves) 
- Oil Cannister (On one of the station's shelves) 
- Coolant Cap x2  (On one of the station's shelves)  
 - Aluminum Can x4

Locations.Title: Wedding Venue Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located along the road west of the Harbor Grand Hotel, the pink house has an abandoned backyard wedding setup behind it, where you’ll find a hidden gift card.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Gift Card](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514341)

Locations.Title: Lobster Buoys House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Angler.

Located along the road west of the Harbor Grand Hotel, the house is covered in lobster buoys. Behind it is a shed with an angler inside, along with a fusion core.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437535)

Locations.Title: Convenience Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Ghouls.

Located northeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the store has a trash can outside. Inside, there is a cigarette machine, trash can, filing cabinet, desk, cash register, toolbox, and a novice-locked safe, all of which can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- Nuka-Cola x3 (Two are on the shelves & one is on a filing cabinet.)
- Coffin Tin (Beside the espresso machine)
- Gas Canister (On the store's shelves)

Locations.Title: Workshop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of Southwest Harbor, this workshop contains an armor workbench, a tool chest, and some scattered junk available for looting. A nearby house with a green door also contains a bureau that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- Wine x2 (On a crate)
- Yum Yum Deviled Eggs (On a crate)
- Oil Can (On top of the tool chest)
- Gas Canister (Beside the armor workbench)
- Aluminum Can (On a crate, and three are on a shelf)
- Bag of Fertilizer x2 (Beside a shelf)

Locations.Title: Public Beach and Dock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of Southwest Harbor, the dock has been extended haphazardly. At the end, a lantern illuminates the skeletal remains of a woman in a pink dress. Various liquor bottles are scattered along the dock leading to her, with a box containing various liquor next to her.

**Notable Loot:**
- Fashionable Glasses (Skeleton in a pink dress)

Locations.Title: Southern Long Pond
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Anglers & Yao Guai.

There’s an island in the lake with a skeleton lying on a couch and a toolbox beside it. Yao Guai are encountered on the north side, with Anglers ambushing from the water on either side.

**Notable Loot:**
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (On the couch on the island in the pond)
- Cram (On the couch on the island in the pond)

*- Note: There is no canon name for this body of water, so the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

Locations.Title: Kitterredge Pass Exit
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Ghouls.**

This is the unmarked exit, for [Kitterredge Pass](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72337#L) to the east.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sutton Island Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Fog Crawler.

Located southeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360) the camp has a lone dead trapper, a cooking station, and, to loot, a suitcase and a collapsed tent.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

Locations.Title: Sutton Island House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the house is the only permanent structure on the island. There’s a sleeping bag near the house, with two filing cabinets, a first aid kit, and an Expert-locked floor safe by the bed inside to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

Locations.Title: Huntress Island Red Cabin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Yao Guai.

Located on the northwest corner of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), there’s a variety of home-style junk to loot, along with a lunch pail, and a Nuka-Cherry in the fridge. A severely damaged cabin east of the red cabin has a few minor pieces of junk.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Nuka-Cherry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566727)

Locations.Title: Burning Boats
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied

Located off the north side of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), on the rocky skerry where the large boats are trapped, you’ll find two garden gnomes, three Molotov cocktails, and an explosives crate, suggesting the gnomes started the fire. 

On the small wooden sail boat next to the skerry, you’ll find two more garden gnomes, along with human bones and a net, suggesting the gnomes are pulling bones out of the water.

**Notable Loot:**
- Molotov Cocktail x3 (Next to the gnomes on the skerry)
- Sunglasses (Worn by gnome on the small sail boat)

Locations.Title: Huntress Island Green House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located on the east side of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), the house has two skeletons: a man lying on the couch watching TV, and a woman on the second floor doing the laundry. There’s various home-style junk to loot, along with a toolbox, washer, dryer, and dresser.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Huntress Island Public Beach
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Angler.

Located on the east side of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), there’s a weapon workbench, a dead radstag, and a suitcase to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Sea Captain's Hat (Worn by a mannequin)

Locations.Title: Skerry by Baker Island Lighthouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurks. 

Located southeast of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), the skerry and surrounding water have minor pieces of junk suggesting the area is polluted, such as antifreeze and oil canisters. 

Of special note, a partially submerged lighthouse and building can be seen southeast of the skerry, outside the playable area of the map, making them inaccessible without mods. The building is a store with a cash register, suitcase, and unlocked safe, while there’s a steamer trunk at the top of the lighthouse.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

*- Note: There is no canon name for the lighthouse; the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, which heavily inspired the Far Harbor DLC. Huntress Island takes the place of 'Little Cranberry Island', which has a lighthouse on the small Baker Island to its southeast.*

Locations.Title: Murder Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Radstag.

On a small island south off [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), with a fallen tree acting as a bridge between the two islands, the shed has a male mannequin holding a machete next to a beheaded, bloody skeleton, suggesting he murdered them. There’s also a toolbox inside the shed. Outside the shed, a skeleton sits on a bench with a note to their partner.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Love Letter to Bridget](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566716)
- Overdue Book (Next to skeleton on the bench)
- Trilby Hat (Worn by skeleton on the bench)
- Sunglasses (Worn by skeleton on the bench)
- Machete (Held by mannequin in the shack)

Locations.Title: Huntress Island Blue Cabin
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied

Located in the southwest corner of [Huntress Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72609), the cabin has little junk to loot, but it sits beside a fallen tree that connects Huntress Island to a small island to the south.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island's Eastern Skerry
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

The skerry has a suitcase you can loot, along with bits of junk floating in the water around it, such as human bones and antifreeze. Everything you need to have a good time, really.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island's Eastern Isle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located east of Cranberry Island, the isle has a small sailing ship run aground, with a lunch pail and duffle bag to loot. You can also find bits of junk floating in the water around the isle, such as antifreeze.

**Notable Loot:**
- Fishing Rod (On the boat)

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island's Southeastern Isle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the south of the [Cranberry Island Supply Shed](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72608), the island has various junk floating around it like Oil Canisters and Antifreeze, on it you can find a suitcase, steamer trunk, and on a radioactive barrel, a dead fish wearing a gas mask with goggles.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gas Mask with Goggles (worn by dead fish) (probably smells awful)

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island’s Southwestern Isle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of Cranberry Island’s southwest corner. A partially submerged pickup truck on the isle’s coast has a toolbox, wooden crate, and first aid kit to loot, with a small amount of junk nearby, such as an oil canister.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Power Generator 2
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves

Located across the water form the [Huntress Island Blue Cabin](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566733), this is one of three generators on Cranberry Island that must be repaired, and its circuit breaker activated, to open the bunker at [Cranberry Island Bog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72607). 

All three options to fix the circuit board work, including “Jam something metal into it!”

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Power Generator 3
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Yao Guai & Gulper Devourer.

This is one of three generators on Cranberry Island that must be repaired, and its circuit breaker activated, to open the bunker at Cranberry Island Bog. 

All three options to fix the pipe work, including “Bang on it!”

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Collapsing Shoreline Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of Power Generator 3 on Cranberry Island. The home is collapsing into the sea, but still has a few piece of junk to loot along with a cooking station out front.

**Notable Loot:**
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (Next to the home's dock)

Locations.Title: Collapsed Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of Cranberry Island Docks, the home has a console and a wooden box to loot, and a bed to sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- Giddyup Buttercup

Locations.Title: Power Generator 1
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, but possible hostiles from nearby [Cranberry Island Bog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72607).

This is one of three generators on Cranberry Island that must be repaired, and its circuit breaker activated, to open the bunker at [Cranberry Island Bog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72607). 

All three options to fix the wires work, including “Kick it!”

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Home with Collapsed Roof
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of Waves Crest Orphanage, the home's roof is collapsed, but there is still bits of home-style junk to loot, along with a trash bin and a mattress on the second floor to sleep on.  There is also an unlocked wall safe behind the picture that is leaning against the wall at the foot of the stairs. 

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437538)
- Vim (Found in the fridge on the porch)

Locations.Title: Bank
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Hermit Crab in the parking lot.

Located north of Wave Crest Orphanage, the bank has a safe with a novice lock and a Vim machine to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Convenience Store
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Hermit Crab in the parking lot.

Located north of [Waves Crest Orphanage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72358), the convenience store has two washers and a toolbox to loot. A Lobster Grill Family Restaurant food truck just east of the store has a suitcase and duffle bag to loot as well.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Collapsed Homes
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [Waves Crest Orphanage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72358), the two homes have collapsed, but there is still a dresser in one and a washer in the other to loot, along with a small amount of house-themed junk, such as a bread box.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Shipyard Offices
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located northeast of [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), the shipyard’s offices contain a desk, two file cabinets, a cigarette machine, and a floor safe with an expert lock to loot. wooden crate, 

**Notable Loot:**
- Sentry Bot Model (On top of a empty file cabinet)

Locations.Title: Shipyard Wet Docks
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls

Located northeast of [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), the shipyard wet docks are made up of two sections. They contain a dead trapper, a first aid kit on a radioactive boat, a wooden crate under the eastern section’s stairs, and a duffle bag under a bed to loot. There is also the aforementioned bed to sleep in, along with a cooking station.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=567282)
- Vim Captains Blend (Next to Cooking Station)
- Vim (Next to a barrel on the western section's second floor)

Locations.Title: Shipyard Tugboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of Northwood Ridge Quarry, the tugboat, its barge with Vim-labeled equipment, and the red fishing boat beside it have nothing to loot, neither containers nor junk, beyond a single burnt book on the barge.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Shipyard Boat Sheds
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls 

Northeast of [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), in the northwest corner of the shipyard, the two boat sheds are sparsely filled with junk found in a workshop area, including coolant.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Shipyard Workshop & Utility Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls 

Located northeast of [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), in the central area of the shipyard, the utility shed has a fusion generator, while in the workshop there is a tool chest and several piece of junk themed for mechanical work to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437541)

Locations.Title: Shipyard Dry Docked Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Northeast of [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), between the shipyard and the road, there’s a fallen tree you can walk up to reach the boat. Inside, you’ll find a safe with an advanced lock and a first aid kit.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Hermit Crab in the parking lot.

Located north of [Waves Crest Orphanage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72358), the restaurant has a trash bin out front and a first aid kit inside to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Grape Mentats (On a table inside)

Locations.Title: Trapper House & Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers

Located south of the Northwood Ridge Quarry, the garage has a toolbox to loot, while the house has two dressers to loot and a mattress you can sleep on, plus a mailbox out front on the road.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Crashed Red Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359) by a bridge, the truck’s trailer is empty, but there’s a suitcase to loot by the trailer door.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Collapsed Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of the [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), the home still has some house-themed junk to loot, along with a wooden crate, suitcase, and cooler. There’s also a mattress, but it can’t be slept on.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Blue House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of the [Northwood Ridge Quarry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72357), the house has an ammo box, fridge, suitcase, cooler, and toolbox to loot, along with some home-themed junk. There’s also a mattress, but it’s damaged and can’t be slept on.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sinking Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Fog Crawl on the road and a Gulper Devourer in the water.

Located northwest of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), this home has several lootable items: a wooden crate, toolbox, duffle bag, an unlocked wall safe in the bedroom, and a cooler in the boat by the home. There is also a bed, but it cannot be slept in.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Crumbling Sinking Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Fog Crawl on the road and a Gulper Devourer in the water.

Located northwest of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), this home has two lootable containers: a wooden crate and a suitcase. There is also a bed on the second floor, but it can only be reached with a jet pack and cannot be slept in anyway.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Gott's Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), the island has a steamer trunk on its southern coast. Farther south, beyond the playable area, an antenna of an empty sunken fishing ship protrudes from the water. It can be viewed with the console’s tfc command if you're playing on PC.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

Locations.Title: Sunken Red Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), the ship’s cargo has spilled out, including a wooden crate and a steamer trunk to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Halloween House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), the house is decorated for Halloween. Inside are a lootable duffle bag, household junk, and a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- Garden Gnome (Front step)

Locations.Title: Caved-In Houses
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), the two houses are severely damaged, with only a sleeping bag by a burning barrel and little junk to loot. West of them, a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant truck has a lootable suitcase and duffle bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Patriotic Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located slightly northwest of [Waves Crest Orphanage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72358), the home has a patriotic bunting out front. It has no lootable containers, but contains plenty of household junk, including several TV dinner trays.

**Notable Loot:**
- Blood Paint (On second floor, by Nuka-Cola Machine)

Locations.Title: Sunken White Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located south of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), the boat is fully submerged underwater. Onboard, you can loot two lunch pails and a first aid kit.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Dead Man's Trunk
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Fog Crawler.**

Located southeast of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), the long skeleton lies against a tree with a sniper rifle and steamer trunk nearby.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Combat Rifle**: Beside the skeleton.

Locations.Title: Deserted Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Gulpers.**

Located east of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), only the skeletal remains of the campsite’s occupants remain. There’s a duffel bag, collapsed tent, and explosives box to loot, along with two intact tents to sleep in and a cooking station.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Purified Water x3**: One on the picnic table and two on a crate.
- **Instamash**: On a crate.
- **Potted Meat**: On a crate.
- **Cooking Oil**: Beside a large pot.
- **Fish Rod**: On the dock beside the campsite.
- **Aluminum Can**: On the picnic table.

Locations.Title: Sunken Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), a sizable portion of the home’s first floor is underwater. Inside, you can loot a cooler, suitcase, duffel bag, ammo box, and desk, along with a few household items. A near by boat has a suitcase that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Jangles the Moon Monkey**: Beside a first-floor red chair.
- **Office Desk Fan**: Beside a second-floor desk.

Locations.Title: Sinking House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), the house is sinking into the water. Inside, you can loot a toolbox, duffel bag, and suitcase, along with some household items.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese**: Atop a fridge beside the house.
- **Aluminum Can**: Atop a door floating beside the house.

Locations.Title: Blighted Van
