Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though a fog crawler patrols nearby.**

Located south of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the van has an explosive crate you can loot, along with several nearby trees with blight to harvest. There’s a sunken ship south of it, but there’s nothing to loot onboard.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Blight x7**: Can be harvested beside the nearby trees.
- **Aster x2**: Can be harvested beside the nearby trees.

Locations.Title: Sailboat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located east of [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355), the partially submerged boat has a cooler and duffel bag to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Synth Refugees' House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Angler.

Located west of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), this home contains the bodies of two dead synth refugees. Inside are a desk, dresser, duffel bag, ammo box, advanced-locked wall safe, and two sleeping bags. There is also a first aid kit beside an overturned rowboat in the water just west of the house, and an ammo box inside a shipping container on the road in front of the house. 

The attic can only be reached with a jetpack. Up there, three teddy bears appear to be dunking a skeleton into a tub, while one bear holds a toaster and another holds a combat knife. There is also a first aid kit in the sink beside the tub.

**Notable Loot:**
- Teddy Bear x3
- Combat Knife
- Toaster

Locations.Title: Run Aground Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though a lone angler is nearby.**

Located west of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356), the partially submerged wreck has a first aid kit floating above it. Nearby, a rowboat contains a sleeping bag and several items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Cooking Oil**: On the rowboat.
- **Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese**: On the rowboat.
- **Fancy Lads Snack Cakes**: On the rowboat.
- **Canned Dog Food**: On the rowboat.

Locations.Title: Flooded House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), this large house is only partially accessible. Inside, you can find a toolbox, explosives box, and duffle bag to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Dandy Boy Apples**: Atop a rubbish pile beside the kitchen counter.
- **Yum Yum Deviled Eggs**: Atop a rubbish pile beside the kitchen counter.

Locations.Title: Abandoned Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though a fog crawler patrols nearby.**

Located east of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), this campsite is fairly small. It has a blue pickup truck and a tent you can sleep in. There’s a small amount of items to loot, along with a wooden crate.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Cram**: Atop a crate beside the tent.
- **Pork N' Beans**: Atop a crate beside the tent.
- **Fishing Rod**: Atop a crate beside the tent.
- **Aluminum Can**: Atop a crate beside the tent.

Locations.Title: Submerged Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though a fog crawler patrols nearby.**

Located west of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), this shed has nothing inside, but there’s a first aid kit on top of an overturned rowboat, along with a novice-locked safe in another rowboat. Both are close to the shed.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Aluminum Can**: On a door floating in the water.

Locations.Title: Cooking Raft
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located south of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), this raft has a cooking station, but little to loot beyond empty cans and bottles.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Dirty Water**: Beside the cooking station.
- **Aluminum Can x2**: Beside the cooking station.

Locations.Title: Rocky Islet
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of Haddock Cove, this islet is home to a fishing boat that has run aground, with a dead trader and cooler to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Desk Fan**: Beside the dead trader.

Locations.Title: Dangerous Shoal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), this shoal has a tugboat buried in it, with a large sailboat sunken on top. There are three explosive crates to loot, along with a skeleton hanging out of one of the tugboat’s windows holding a fusion core.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484607)**

Locations.Title: Scientist's Raft
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the raft is occupied by a skeleton wearing a Vault-Tec lab coat, with a suitcase beside it to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Flooded House & Garage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located south of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the garage contains a toolbox, while the house has two dressers to loot. The house's lone bed cannot be slept in, but there is a red chair where you can sit and wait.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Oil Canister**: Floating in the water beside the house.
- **Suprathaw Antifreeze**: Floating in the water beside the house.

Locations.Title: Children of Atom House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located east of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the house has several loot containers in and around the property. The garage contains a large toolbox and a first aid kit, while a picnic table beside the house has a tool case. Near the water, the shed contains a cooler and an ice cooler, a large toolbox sits beside the red tractor, and another toolbox is submerged beneath the dock.

Inside the house, a dresser can be found on the first floor, and there is a bed on the second floor. The third floor contains a Children of Atom banner, along with the home’s most notable loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[A Vengeful Creature](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484225)**
- **[A Safe Way](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484226)**
- **[A Stranger Arrives](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484228)**
- **[The Children Trapped](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484227)**
- **[Stealth Boy x3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571893)**
- **Adjustable Wrench x2**: On the picnic table and atop the tractor.
- **Mr. Handy Fuel**: On the picnic table.
- **Oil Can**: On top of the red tractor.
- **Aluminum Can**: Inside the shed.
- **Suprathaw Antifreeze**: Near the red tractor.

Locations.Title: Lobster Buoys Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, with Gulpers patrolling nearby.**

Located just north of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), this home has two dressers, a washer, and a dryer to loot, along with a good amount of household junk. It also contains a cooking stove and a bed you can sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Purified Water x2**: On the kitchen counter.
- **Alarm Clock x2**: Outside beside the front door & on a dresser.
- **Coffee Tin**: On the kitchen counter.
- **Garden Gnome**: Outside beside the front door.

Locations.Title: Trapper Ambush
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Trappers.**

Located on the road north of [Zephyr Ridge Camp](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72351), the trappers will ambush you from the brush. Nearby, there is a car with the skeleton of a woman who appears to have been trying to fix it, along with a large toolbox and suitcase you can loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Jangles the Moon Monkey**: Next to the large toolbox.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: Held by the skeleton.

Locations.Title: Roofless House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located north of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the house contains a refrigerator and an advanced-locked floor safe to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese**: On the kitchen counter.
- **Instamash**: On the kitchen counter.
- **Cooking Oil**: On the kitchen counter.

Locations.Title: Bartlett Island House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located southeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), this house includes a dock, shed, and garage. A suitcase can be found floating near the sunken boat by the dock, and a toolbox is in the garage. Inside the home are two file cabinets and two desks to loot, along with various household and workshop junk. An armor workbench is also located in the shed.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
-  **Mentats**: Beside the armor workbench.
- **Salisbury Steak**: Inside the kitchen.
- **Yum Yum Deviled Eggs**: Inside the kitchen.
- **Used Oil Can**: Beside the armor workbench & inside the garage.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: Inside the garage.
- **Typewriter**: On a desk on the second floor of the house.

Locations.Title: Hardwood Island Sailboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Gulpers.**

Located north of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), a sailboat can be found run aground along the island’s shore. On the sailboat is a skeleton clutching a fusion core, along with three cartons of cigarettes and a box of cigars.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437536)**
- **Undamaged Cigarettes**
- **Cigarette Carton x2**
- **Cigar Box**
- **Pack of Cigarettes**

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Random Hostiles.**

Located west of [Zephyr Ridge Camp](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72351), this camp has a duffle bag and wooden crate to loot. It also includes two tents, a sleeping bag you can use to sleep, and a cooking station. 

Beware of fragmentation mines placed around the camp.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Fragmentation Mine x3**: Placed around the campsite.

Locations.Title: Yacht Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located west of [Zephyr Ridge Camp](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72351), there is a skeleton clinging to wreckage with a lantern and toothpaste, while a suitcase floats in the water that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Hardwood Island Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a Gulper in the tree next to the safe.**

Located northwest of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the novice-lock safe is found at the bottom of a tree.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Inaccessible Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northwest of DiMA's Cache, this island lies outside the playable area of the map and cannot be accessed without using a mod (or the 'tcl' console command). There is a lootable toolbox and fridge, but nothing else of note.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Unreachable Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied

Located southwest of DiMA's Cache, this island lies outside the playable area of the map and cannot be accessed without using a mod. It contains a lootable wooden crate and a machete stabbed into the sand beside a skeleton.

**Notable Loot:**
- Machete

Locations.Title: Rowboat Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Gulpers.**

Located northwest of Rayburn Point, the rowboat has run aground in the sand, with a safe secured with an advanced lock onboard.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Salvager's Crate
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located north of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), a skeleton can be found on floating wreckage alongside a wooden crate and bobby pins, suggesting they successfully picked the crate’s lock before meeting their end.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Bobby Pins**: Beside the wooden crate.

Locations.Title: Flooded House & Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located just north of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the house contains a suitcase and a wooden crate to loot, while a nearby rowboat holds an unlocked safe. The larger white boat contains a large toolbox and a unique safe, as noted below.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Zeke's Safe](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591686)**
- **Buffout**: Beside the suitcase in the house.
- **Sledgehammer**: In the rowboat.

Locations.Title: Partially Accessible Tugboat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks, including a Queen.**
 
Located near DiMA's Cache. Only the rear of the tugboat and the tip of the island it has run aground on are within the playable area, so a mod or the 'tcl' console command is required to access the rest. A duffle bag and wooden crate are aboard the tugboat, but both are beyond the playable boundary. 

Mirelurks can be fought, but cannot be looted unless they are lured into the playable map.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Inaccessible Yacht Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located near DiMA's Cache. The wreck lies outside the game's playable area and requires a mod or the 'tcl' console command to access. A suitcase can be found floating nearby, and a skeleton clutching a pole hook lies next to the ship.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Pole Hook**: Held by a skeleton.

Locations.Title: Inaccessible Fishing Boat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located near DiMA's Cache. The wreck lies outside the game's playable area and requires a mod or the 'tcl' console command to access. There is a suitcase and cooler onboard, along with a Nuka-Cola Quantum.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=575432)**

Locations.Title: Crashed Pickup
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the pickup has a toolbox and duffle bag to loot, along with two skeletons nearby holding fishing rods. A little farther north along the road from the crash is a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant van with a suitcase and duffle bag to loot as well.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mentats**: Beside the toolbox.
- **Whiskey**: Beside the skeleton closer to the beach.
- **Fishing Rod x2**: One is beside each skeleton.

Locations.Title: Derelict Dock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), you’ll find a dock with a novice-locked suitcase and an ammo box in a rowboat. There is also a lunch pail nearby, plus a cooler and first aid kit on the partially submerged fishing boat that can be looted.  

A suitcase can be found floating in the water just south of the dock. On the island west of the dock, there is a lone Yao Guai, but nothing to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Fishing Rod**: Beside the lunch pail.

Locations.Title: Shit Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks.**

Located north of Rayburn Point, this island sits outside the game’s playable area and requires a mod (or the 'tcl' console command) to access. On the island, a skeleton lies under a tent with a teddy bear and toy car nearby, along with four wooden blocks spelling out S-H-I-T.  There is also a suitcase floating west of the island, a toolbox and wooden crate by the boat wreck, and a first aid kit near the skeleton.  

**Notable Loot:**
- **Wooden Block x4**
- **Teddy Bear**
- **Toy Car**

Locations.Title: Landslide-Destroyed House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Super Mutants.**

Located northeast of Rayburn Point, the remains of the house have a fridge, desk, and ammo box to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Teddy Bear (Large-Size)**: Beside the house's sole surviving desk.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Boat & Vehicles
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located north of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), there’s a fridge, toolbox, and cooler by the car and pickup, plus an ammo box by the boat, along with a skeleton clutching a bottle of Vim.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Vim**: Held by the skeleton whose legs are pinned by the boat.

Locations.Title: Inaccessible Wrecked Yacht
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the yacht is beyond the playable area of the map and requires a mod (or the 'tcl' console command) to access. There’s only a suitcase floating nearby in the water to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Submerged House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, but Gulper nearby in Lure Weeds.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the flooded house has a desk inside and a suitcase floating in the water nearby to loot, along with a cigar-smoking teddy bear on a miniature ship inside.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Sea Captain's Hat**: Worn by a teddy bear on a miniature boat.
- **Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese**: Inside the kitchen fridge.
- **Oil Cannister**:  Floating in the water beside the house.
- **Used Oil Can**: On a piece of wood floating inside the house.
- **Lantern**: On a piece of wood floating inside the house.
- **Aluminum Can**: On a piece of wood floating inside the house.

Locations.Title: Boat Wreck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located west of [Briney’s Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), the split wreck has a wooden crate and suitcase nearby to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Industrial Oil Canister**: In a shopping cart beside the boat.
- **Gas Cannister**: Floating beside the boat.

Locations.Title: Storage Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, with wolves patrolling nearby.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the shed contains a cooler, toolbox, and duffle bag to loot. The upper part of the shed can be reached by climbing the fallen tree leaning against it. There is also a cooking station and a skeleton surrounded by several bottles of Gwinnett beer.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Gwinnett Pale**
- **Gwinnett Lager**
- **Gwinnett Pilsner**
- **Ragstag Meat**

Locations.Title: Trapper House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a sole Trapper.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the house contains a suitcase, cooler, novice-locked first aid kit, and master-locked safe to loot. There is also a cooking station inside the home, and a lunch pail can be looted on the dock behind it.  

**Notable Loot:** 
- **Shovel**: Beside a shelf. *Required to dig up [Dylan's Stash](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590038).*
- **Industrial Size Shortening**: On the kitchen table.
- **Desk Fan**: On the desk beside the master-locked safe.
- **Mirelurk Meat x2**: Both are in the kitchen.
- **Brahmin Meat**: Inside the kitchen fridge.
- **Bloodbug Meat**: Inside the kitchen fridge.

Locations.Title: Trapper Workshop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a sole Trapper.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), this location contains a tool chest, cabinet, ice cooler, cooler, ammo box, and an expert-locked steamer trunk on the second floor to loot. There is also a chemistry station and weapons workbench. 
Beware of fragmentation mines on the ground. 

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Dylan's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484606)**
- **Shovel**: Beside the weapons workbench. *[Dylan's Stash](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590038)*
- **Buffout**: Beside the chemistry station.
- **Fragmentation Mine x5**: Spread around the workshop.
- **Gas Cannister x3**: All three are near the weapons workbench.
- **Used Oil Can**: On the same shelf as the toolbox.
- **Adjustable Wrench**: On the same shelf as the toolbox.

Locations.Title: Dylan's Stash
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), this stash is found beneath an interactive pile of dirt called “Buried Stash,” next to a gravestone. It becomes visible and accessible after picking up [Dylan's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484606) in the large [workshop](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590036) west of the grave. The stash contains a predetermined number of lootable items, as listed below.

*A shovel is required to dig up the stash. One can be found in the [workshop](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590036), and another is located in the [house](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590035) next to the stash.*

**Notable Loot:** 
- **[Stimpak x3](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=590040)**
- **Buffjet x5**
- **Berserk Syringe x10**
- **Short Syringer Rifle**

Locations.Title: Run Aground Yacht
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located east of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), this boat has no containers onboard except for a caps stash. However, several pieces of random junk can be found there, including a Giddyup Buttercup Body and a Cake Pan.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Industrial Oil Canister**: In a shopping cart beside the yacht.
- **Cake Pan**: Onboard the yacht.

Locations.Title: Folly Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located southeast of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the small rocky island has a wooden crate with a Jangles the Moon Monkey beside it. The tiny isle nearby has a couch with two pieces of junk on it.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this island, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **Jangles the Moon Monkey**: Beside the wooden crate.
- **Toy Alien**: On the couch on the nearby tiny isle.
- **Alarm Clock**: On the couch on the nearby tiny isle.

Locations.Title: Desolate Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied

Located southwest of the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359), there is a wooden crate to loot, a small amount of junk, and a tent to sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Kawaketak Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located east of the [Children of Atom Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=80462), only one of the three cabins can be entered. Inside the cabin are two dressers and a first aid kit to loot, along with various junk items lying about. An ammo box can also be found in front of another cabin. While there is no place to sleep, the couch inside the cabin can be used to wait.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Gwyneth's Journal](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357150)
- Blood Paint (Inside the cabin)

Locations.Title: Seal Cove Pond
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers in Lure Weed.

Located east of the [Children of Atom Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=80462), the pond has no notable junk or containers to loot, instead it has the normal plants to harvest, such as Lure Weed. There are still things to loot and enemies to battle at locations along the ponds sides, but nothing outside of them.

*There is no canon name for this body of water, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

Located 
**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Conflict-Ridden House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers vs random hostiles.

Located south of the [Glowing Grove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72349), the house is a battleground between two random groups of hostiles, such as the Children of Atom and Trappers. A pickup next to the house has a toolbox and duffle bag to loot, but the remnants of the house only have bits of junk to collect.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Seal Cove Pond Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, but patrolling wolves to its east.**

Located northwest of the [Glowing Grove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72349), the shed has a handmade tripwire at each doorway, with a fragmentation grenade hanging from each one. Inside, there is a toolbox to loot and several bags of cement.

*There is no canon name for this body of water, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **Fragmentation Grenade x2**: Hanging from the ceiling. 
- **Bag of Cement x2**: In a corner of the shed.

Locations.Title: Pet Cemetery
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mole Rats.

Located southwest of the [Glowing Grove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72349), the cemetery has no containers to loot, but there are items left at the gravestones of several pets.

**Notable Loot:**
- Red Bandana
- Dog Collar
- Baseball

Locations.Title: Ruined Workshop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Random Hostiles.

Located northwest of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the workshop’s remains have a toolbox and assorted lootable items lying about, as well as a mattress, two sleeping bags, and a cooking station.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Ruined Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a Yao Guai. 

Located northwest of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the camp is implied to have been destroyed by a yao guai. There is a collapsed tent and a duffle bag to loot, along with a number of items, including the human bones of the unlucky camper.

**Notable Loot:**
- Human Bones

Locations.Title: Super Mutant Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

Located southeast of the [Radiant Crest Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72350), the house has two meat bags, two ammo boxes, and a refrigerator to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gulper Innards x2 (Roasting over a fire)

Locations.Title: Gas Station
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located southeast of the [Radiant Crest Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72350), the gas station has a news stand, mailbox, chem box, cash register, trash can, file cabinet, desk, ice cooler, and Nuka-Cola machine to loot. Behind the gas station’s store is the unmarked [Basement Armory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=509676), which is secured with a novice lock.

**Notable Loot:**
- Ice Cold Nuka-Cola (On a shelf near the trash can)
- Coffee Tin x2 (Next to the espresso machine)
- Oil Cannister (Shed beside the gas station)
- Used Oil Can (On a shelf near the front door)

Locations.Title: Hidden Utility Room
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Mirelurks**

Located southwest of [Echo Lake Lumber](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72346), the flooded utility room is accessed through a culvert. It contains an Advanced-locked safe submerged underwater and a toolbox on a shelf.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Tarberry x3**: Found floating on the water just outside the culvert.

Locations.Title: Collapsing Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located north of [Briney's Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), the home has partially collapsed down the hillside. Inside, there is a first aid kit, a tool case, and a wooden crate to loot, along with a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Med-X**: On the second-floor mattress.
- **Mentats**: On top of the second-floor dresser.
- **Pork N' Beans**: On top of the second-floor dresser.
- **Potato Crisps**: Beside the second-floor mattress.
- **Oil Cannister**: Beside the front door.
- **Aluminum Can x3**: Remains of the house down the hill.

Locations.Title: Ghoul Infested Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Feral Ghouls.**

Located north of [Briney's Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), the home is infested with feral ghouls. It contains a cooler, a toolbox, and a dresser to loot, along with a bed to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Rad-X**: On the second floor stereo.
- **Undamaged Camera**: On the kitchen table.
- **Coffee Tin**: On the kitchen counter.

Locations.Title: Fishing Hut
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Trapper**

Located west of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the hut has no containers or notable loot, but it does have a cooking station and mattress.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sunken Rowboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located west of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the rowboat can be found by two lobster buoys floating above the surface. It is near the island with the fishing shack and contains a cooler and an ammo box to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Angler Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Anglers.**

Located west of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), this area contains no lootable containers. However, it has an abundance of lure weed and Angler meat.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Lure Weed x7**: Can be harvested.

Locations.Title: Ship Graveyard
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612), this tight cluster of shipwrecks has little loot beyond an explosives box on the grounded barge and an ammo box on a sunken white vessel.

Its most notable feature is a likely Titanic easter egg: a skeleton clinging to a floating red door with a silver locket on it.

**Notable Loot:**
- Silver Locket (Floating red door)
- Human Bones (Beside the explosives box on the grounded barge)

Locations.Title: Sofa Shoal
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), this shoal is marked only by the sofa resting on top of it. A cooler sits nearby on a raft, while a skeleton on the sofa clutches a Jangles the Moon Monkey.

**Notable Loot:**
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (On sofa)

Locations.Title: Crashed Boat & Barge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurks.

Located southeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the boat contains only a wooden crate to loot; there is nothing on the barge.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Unburied Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the unlocked safe is found in a dug-up grave beside a skeleton with a shovel.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Land Bridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers. 

Located north of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612), this makeshift land bridge spans across the lake. Though there is nothing to loot, Gulpers guard its western side, waiting in the trees to drop onto unsuspecting victims.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat & Car
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the boat has a first aid kit to loot. Swimming north toward the nearby sunken car reveals a pile of containers, including a novice-locked ammo box, an advanced-locked explosives box, a duffle bag, and another ammo box.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Broken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a lone Angler.

Located southeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the boat has a first aid kit and wooden crate to loo.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Ruined Home & Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a lone Yao Guai.

Located northeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the trailer contains two lootable desks. The home has an advanced-locked safe and a bed, with a tool chest located in the shed outside.

**Notable Loot:**
- Cooking Oil (In kitchen sink)
- Silver Pocket Watch (On top of the safe)

Locations.Title: Crashed Flatbed Truck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located just northeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), there’s an explosive box and a tool case you can loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Red Rocket
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone feral ghoul.**

Located northeast of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the station has a ice cooler, cash register, two cap stashes, and a advance-locked floor safe to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Toy Rocketship:** Under the cash register

Locations.Title: Tannery Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghoul.

Located next to [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334), the restaurant contains only a first aid kit to loot. However, there are several restaurant-related items scattered around the area, along with two trash bins on the adjacent boardwalk.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Stimpak](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591681)
- Vim (On a counter in the restaurant)
- Soup (On the external restroom's counter)

Locations.Title: Emmet's Causeway
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located east of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the small, low-lying islands of the causeway are involved in the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Rite of Passage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516665). 

During the quest, a Far Harbor resident named Dottie will be present to watch the player battle three waves of mirelurks, with the final wave featuring a Mirelurk Queen.

An ammo box in a rowboat is the only lootable container on the islands.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Suprathaw Antifreeze**: Floating in the water beside the rowboat.
- **Oil Canister**: Floating in the water beside the rowboat.

Locations.Title: Trapper House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located northeast of [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334), the house contains only a cooler to loot, though several other items can be found inside and outside, including a used oil can and an alarm clock.

**Notable Loot:**
- Alarm Clock (Beside the kitchen sink)
- Used Oil Can (Inside the fridge)
- Adjustable Wrench (Beside a burning barrel)

Locations.Title: Trapper House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located northeast of [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334), the house contains only a cooler to loot, though several other items can be found inside and outside, including a used oil can and an alarm clock.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Conflict-Ridden Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Two Battling Random Groups of Hostiles.

Located just southwest of [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334), the shack contains a suitcase, dryer, ice cooler, and two dressers to loot, along with a few loose items and a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- Rum (On top of a dresser)
- Jet (On top of a dresser)
- Potato Chips x2 (On top of a dresser)
- Mirelurk Cake (On top of a dresser)

Locations.Title: Zeke's Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Found on a wrecked boat north of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the safe contains predetermined loot, as listed under notable loot.

*It may belong to Zeke from the [Atom Cats Garage](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71921) in the Commonwealth, given the greaser jacket and jeans found inside. It may have been intended for content cut from the DLC before release. Hopefully, he won't mind you looting it.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Stealth Boy](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=575433)**
- **Greaser Jack and Jeans**
- **Sunglasses**
- **Teddy Bear**
- **Burnt Grognak Comic**
- **Burnt Manta-Man Comic**
- **Burnt Unstoppables Comic**

Locations.Title: Trapper Floating Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located north of the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359), the outpost has a duffle bag, toolbox, and several cans of paint to loot, along with a cooking station and bed to use.

**Notable Loot:**
- Yellow Paint (Upper floor of the outpost)
- Blue Paint (Upper floor of the outpost)
- Paint Can x2 (Upper floor of the outpost)
- Gas Cannister (In the water beside the outpost)
- Oil Cannister (Just north of the outpost, beside a life preserver)

Locations.Title: Necromancer Garden Gnome
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359), the garden gnome is found wearing a capless skull as a mask, surrounded by human bones. 

*DiMA’s hidden sixth memory, buried even deeper than the rest for everyone’s safety, came from the night he crossed paths with this gnome. It's a miracle that he escaped!*

**Notable Loot:**
- Garden Gnome (of Doom!)
- Human Bones (of the gnome's enemies!)

Locations.Title: Fishing Sailboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a patrolling Fog Crawler.

Located east of the [Ruined Radio Tower](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72611), the ship has a first aid kit and an ammo box to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Sea Captain's Hat (Worn by a skeleton on the ship)

Locations.Title: Buried Ship
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a patrolling Fog Crawler.

Located east of the [Ruined Radio Tower](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72611), the ship is inaccessible, having been buried, but a nearby toolbox can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Roadside Shop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves. 

Located southwest of [Pine Crest Cavern](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72614), the shop contains a lunch pail, a cigarette machine, a cash register, and an Advanced-locked safe beneath the register. Nearby, a culvert contains brain fungus to harvest.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Trapper Hilltop Outpost
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trapper.

Located southwest of  [Horizon Flight 1207](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72336), the outpost contains a first aid kit, an explosives box, two ammo boxes, a wood crate, a chem box, and a steamer trunk atop the westernmost structure.

**Notable Loot:**
- TV Dinner Tray (Beside a sleeping bag)

Locations.Title: Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls

Located north of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), the restaurant contains a cooler, a small amount of restaurant-themed junk to loot, and a cooking station. The lobster shack down by the pier next to the restaurant also has an ice cooler to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Radaway (Restaurant's Kitchen)
- Fragmentation Grenade x3 (Outhouse)

Locations.Title: Radioactive Safe
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), the unlocked safe is found next to a tree and radioactive barrels on the small island.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Guarded Bridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Super Mutants.**

Located southeast of the [Dalton Farm](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72331), there is nothing of note to loot, but super mutants block the way for those seeking to cross.

**Notable Loot:**
- **None**

Locations.Title: Workshop & Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located northwest of the [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), the trailer is empty, but the workshop has a toolbox to loot, along with a few pieces of junk.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Imploded House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), there are no containers to loot, but the house has several household items available.

**Notable Loot:**
- Industrial Size Shortening (Kitchen counter)

Locations.Title: Roadside Rest Stop
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located northwest of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), there is a chem box in a restroom, along with a suitcase inside the bus at the rest stop. There is also a garden gnome in a restroom stall, making fish and carrot soup in a toilet.

**Notable Loot:**
- Vim (Held by a skeleton beside the restroom door)
- Garden Gnome (Restroom stall)

Locations.Title: Derelict Homes and Dock
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), the two homes have little to no loot, aside from a mailbox in front of the blue-roofed home and a dresser inside the red house. In the dock's structure, there is also a sleeping bag that can be used to sleep.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Acadia National Park Gatehouse
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [Acadia](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72615), at the beginning of the road to the synth refuge, the gatehouse contains a lunch pail and a desk to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Vim! Flatbed Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of the [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), there is a crashed bus next to a Vim! flatbed trailer. Inside the bus, you’ll find a suitcase and cooler to loot, while the flatbed trailer contains a power armor with a green Vim! Refresh paint job.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Carlo's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591950)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591948)
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72710)

Locations.Title: Salvager's Sailboat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), the sailboat is occupied by the skeletal remains of a woman who appears to have been attempting to salvage an intact Giddyup Buttercup from the ocean with a net. There is a first aid kit and an ammo box onboard to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Giddyup Buttercup (In a net hanging off the sailboat)

Locations.Title: Washed Ashore Teddy Bear
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though an Angler is sleeping up off the beach.**

Located northwest of the [Cliff's Edge Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72328), there is a larger-sized teddy bear found on a door washed ashore along the beach, appearing to have made itself mirelurk egg soup.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Teddy Bear (Large-sized version)**

Locations.Title: Sunken Boat
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located in the water just north of [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324)'s [The Last Plank](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563613), the boat has a first aid kit to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Dead Trapper's Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers in the trees.

Located northwest of the island with [Longfellow's Cabin](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72325), the island’s eastern side has a shack with a dead trapper and an ammo box to loot, along with a sleeping bag to sleep in. The north side of the island has a wrecked boat with a first aid kit, while the western side has a novice-locked shed containing a novice-locked safe and a chem box to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Oil Cannister (Inside the shed)
- Fishing Rod (On the dock)

Locations.Title: Lost-at-Sea Teddy Bear
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of the island with [Longfellow's Cabin](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72325), there is a shattered door floating on the water with a larger-sized teddy bear on top, stranded alongside some empty cans and a carton of dirty water.

**Notable Loot:**
- Teddy Bear (Larger-sized version)

Locations.Title: Empty Beachside Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), the camp has an explosives box, a toolbox, and a collapsed tent to loot, along with a set-up tent to sleep in.

There is an Angler sleeping by an empty shipwrecked fishing boat on the beach next to the camp.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Trapper Beach House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers.

Located north of the [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), the house has a mailbox and an advanced-locked tool chest to loot, along with a cooking station and a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Washed Away Home
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied, though there are Mirelurks on the beach behind the home.

Located north of the [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), much of the home has washed away. However, there is still a cooler, a fridge, and a novice-locked wooden crate to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Mirelurk Bridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Mirelurk.**

Located east of the [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333), there is a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant crashed by the bridge. It contains a suitcase and duffle bag to loot, along with mirelurk eggs to harvest on the bridge.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mirelurk Eggs**

Locations.Title: Gulper Island
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Gulpers.**

Located east of the [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333), the island has nothing to loot, but it is home to gulpers. Check the trees as you approach.

**Notable Loot:**
- **None**

Locations.Title: Washed Ashore Yacht
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located west of the [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333), there is a duffle bag onboard the yacht to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **None**

Locations.Title: Remains of Trenton Bridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a [Hermit Crab](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=510597).**

Located west of the [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333), there is an explosives crate next to the hermit crab on the remains of the bridge.

*There is no canon name for this bridge, instead the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- **None**

Locations.Title: Northern Long Pond
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers, Mirelurk, Feral Ghouls, and Wolves.

Located northwest of [Acadia](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72615), the lake is mainly home to mirelurks and gulpers, with nothing notable to loot beyond the unmarked locations along its shoreline.

*- Note: There is no canon name for this body of water, so the name used is taken from the same location on the real Mount Desert Island, on which the Far Harbor DLC is heavily inspired.*

**Notable Loot:**
- Teddy Bear (Large-size version)
- Mirelurk Eggs (Mirelurk Colony)
- Blight (Mirelurk Colony)

Locations.Title: Lobster Grill Family Restaurant Van
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of [Kitterredge Pass](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72337), the van is by itself along the side of the lake, with a suitcase and duffle bag to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Mirelurk Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Mirelurks.

Located northwest of [Acadia](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72615), the colony has a toolbox to loot, along with mirelurk eggs and a large number of blight to harvest.

**Notable Loot:**
- Mirelurk Eggs
- Blight (Herb)

Locations.Title: Motel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls

Located northwest of the [National Park Campground](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72327), there is a novice-locked suitcase and first aid kit to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Destroyed Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of the [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), there is a toolbox, an explosives box, and two collapsed tents to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Blue Tent Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northwest of the [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), there is a tool case to loot and a sleeping bag to sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- **None**

Locations.Title: Red Tent Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located northwest of the [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), there is a novice-locked tool chest to loot and a chair to sit in.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Mentats (On a small table)**

Locations.Title: National Park Picnic Area
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers and Mirelurks. 

Located southeast of the [National Park Campground](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72327), there is a cooler and dead feral ghouls to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Collapsed Houses
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a lone Yao Guai.**

Located south of the [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333), the three houses have next to nothing to loot, except for the mailboxes in front of each house and a toolbox in the red-trimmed house with the yao guai sleeping beside it. The only other thing of note is a skeleton seated at a table with a teddy bear on a plate in front of it, suggesting it was meant for dinner.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Teddy Bear (Larger-size version)**

Locations.Title: Bathing Teddy Bear
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the [National Park Campground](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72327), the teddy bear is found in a sink floating in the lake, with a fancy hairbrush and bar of soap apparently trying to bathe.

**Notable Loot:**
- Teddy Bear (Large-size version)

Locations.Title: Fishing Shack
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of [National Park HQ](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72330), there are no containers, and there’s not much junk to loot. However, on the north side of the tiny pond the shack sits beside, there’s a chair with a fishing rod.

**Notable Loot:**
- Fishing Rod (Northside of the pond)
- Dog Bowl x2 (Dog houses behind the shack)

Locations.Title: Crumbling House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by a lone Yao Guai.

Located southwest of [National Park Visitor's Center](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72329), the house contains a novice-locked wooden crate and a crate of light bulbs to loot. On the large covered patio next to the house, there’s a garden gnome sitting inside a broken lobster trap.

**Notable Loot:**
- Garden Gnome (Lobster Trap)
- Light Bulb x4 (Crate on the floor)
- Broken Light Bulb (Crate on the floor)

Locations.Title: Crates with Skeletal Remains
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southwest of [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), the crates themselves cannot be looted, but there is a lootable toolbox among them.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: House with Waterfront Patio
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southwest of [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), there is a dresser and an expert-locked floor safe hidden under an empty trash can to loot, plus a cooking station and a mattress to sleep on.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: House with Garage Shed
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

Located southwest of [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332), there is a washer and several already-dead feral ghouls to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Sunken Pickup Truck
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335), the pickup truck is fully submerged underwater next to two explosives boxes to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Oil Cannister (Floating in water near the truck)
- Suprathaw Antifreeze (Floating in water near the truck)

Locations.Title: Clogged Bridge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612), the bridge has an explosives box and a toolbox underneath that can be looted. A random encounter may spawn after looting the containers, with a Deathclaw being one possible encounter.

**Notable Loot:**
- Fort Hagen Armory Password
- Fishing Rod (Under the bridge)

Locations.Title: Red Rocket Fast Coolant Recharger
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northwest of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612), the broken-down automated servicing station has an explosives box that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Gulpher Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Gulpers.

Located northwest of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612), a gulper colony has settled along the washed-out road. Four gulpers lurk in the area, ready to ambush unsuspecting travelers. There are no containers or items to loot here; survival is the only reward.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Collapsed House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326), the house has imploded in on itself, but items can still be found among the remains.

**Notable Loot:**
- Alarm Clock (On the bed's headboard)
- Gum Drops (On the kitchen table)
- Teddy Bear (In the crib)

Locations.Title: Red House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326), a doghouse stands outside the house, which appears to have become home to a pack of wolves ready to attack anyone who approaches it or the Red Rocket next door.

**Notable Loot:**
- Aluminum Can x2 (On the floor of the house)
- Dog Bowl (On the kitchen floor)

Locations.Title: Collapsing House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located southeast of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326), half of the house has collapsed, leaving only a few cans to be found among the ruins.

**Notable Loot:**
- Aluminum Can x1 (On the floor of the house)

Locations.Title: Motel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located east of [Beaver Creek Lanes](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72326), the motel contains two desks inside, with a cigarette machine and mailbox just outside that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Damaged Statue
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the [Ruined Radio Tower](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72611), the statue stands in the center of a roundabout surrounded by several houses. It is unclear who the statue depicts, though it may be based on Joshua Chamberlain, the 32nd Governor of Maine and a Medal of Honor recipient, whose statue in Bowdoin, Maine, bears a similar appearance.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Dug-Up Grave
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located south of the [Ruined Radio Tower](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72611), this grim scene leaves more questions than answers. Between a dug-up grave with a baby stroller and a rowboat with the skeletal remains of a couple, you’ll find a wooden crate to loot, along with several scattered items.

**Notable Loot:**
- Garden Gnome (In the baby stroller)
- Molotov Cocktail (In the baby stroller)
- Jangles the Moon Monkey (Beside the two skeletons)
- Mr. Handy Fuel (In the rowboat)
- Camera (In the rowboat)
- Sugar Bombs x2 (In the shopping cart)
- Pork N' Bean (In the shopping cart)

Locations.Title: Deathclaw Nest
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by a Deathclaw.**

Located east of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the nest has two deathclaw nest piles and a wooden crate to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Vim! Pop Trailer
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the Vim! Pop trailer is secured with a novice-lock, inside there are two skeletons next to a crate with Vim! Pop drinks.

**Notable Loot:**
- Vim Quartz (In the crate found inside the trailer)
- Vim x3 (In the crate found inside the trailer)
- Submachine Gun (Next to a skeleton inside the trailer)

Locations.Title: House with Gaping-Hole
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the house has a dresser to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Alarm Clock (On top of the dresser)
- Gas Cannister (Beside the yellow car in front of the house)

Locations.Title: Half-Collapsed House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the house has a dryer down the hillside to loot and a bed by the front door to sleep in.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Roofless House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354), the house has three dressers to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gold Plated Flip Lighter (On top of a dresser)
- Toy Rocketship (On top of a dresser)
- Alarm Clock (On top of a dresser)

Locations.Title: Campsite
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located west of [Pine Crest Cavern](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72614), the campsite contains the skeletal remains of its former occupants beside the tent. A wooden crate and duffle bag can be looted, and the tent can be used for sleeping.

**Notable Loot:**
- Gold Watch (On the crate with the lantern)
- Prosnap Camera (Beside the crate with the lantern)
- Aluminum Can (Beside the crate with the lantern)
- Human Bones (Beside the tent)

Locations.Title: Seaside House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the house has a dresser and a small handful of items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Cooking Oil (On the kitchen counter)
- Cake Pan (On the kitchen counter)

Locations.Title: Ruined Houses
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the two houses and the shed behind them contain little to no loot. The house with the green door contains a ham radio, though it appears to serve no purpose beyond being turned on and off.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Green House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located north of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the house contains bureau and several items to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Red Roof House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the house contains a dresser and a few items that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- Alarm Clock (On the dresser)

Locations.Title: Medical Clinic
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

Located northeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the clinic contains a desk, three filing cabinets, and a first aid kit that can be looted. Outside, there is also a news stand, trash can, and mailbox to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- Typewriter (On the receptionist's desk)
- TV Dinner Tray (On the floor)
- Surgical Tray x5 (Two of them are on a filing cabinet)
- Alarm Clock (On a desk)
- Bone Cutter (On a desk)
- Biometric Scanner (On a table beside a bed)

Locations.Title: Restaurant
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Wolves.

Located northeast of [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360), the restaurant contains a news stand, trash can, and trash bin that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Angler Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Anglers.**

Located southwest of [Briney's Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), the colony occupies the shallow waters, where lure weed can be harvested.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Lure Weed x10**: Available to be harvested.

Locations.Title: Angler Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Anglers.**

Located northwest of [Briney's Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), the colony occupies the shallow waters, where lure weed can be harvested.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Lure Weed x4**: Available to be harvested.

Locations.Title: Angler Colony
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Anglers.**

Located northwest of [Rayburn Point](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72348), the colony occupies the shallow waters of the atoll, where lure weed can be harvested. There is a nearby [safe](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=575418) on a rowboat.  

**Notable Loot:**
- **Lure Weed x11**: Available to be harvested.

Locations.Title: Broken House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied, though Gulpers are nearby.**

Located east of [Haddock Cove](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72353), the flooded remains of the house contain a partially submerged, unlocked safe that can be looted.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese**: Inside the refrigerator.
- **Toy Alien**: On the seesaw.
- **Teddy Bear**: On the seesaw.

Locations.Title: Wrecked Yacht
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Unoccupied.**

Located south of [Rock Point Camp](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72352), the yacht has split in half on the shore with a cooler to loot.

**Notable Loot:**
- **Oil Canister**: Floating in the water beside the yacht.
- **Suprathaw Antifreeze**: Floating in the water beside the yacht.

Locations.Title: National Park Campground
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

The campground is connected to the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Blood Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516660), given by Cassie Dalton, which requires eliminating all of the area’s feral ghouls.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Briney's Bait and Tackle
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Hermit Crab and later random hostiles.

The location is not connected to any specific quests or notable items, but there are still several containers to loot, various items on the shelves, and a sleeping bag.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Stimpak x2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=594036)
- Scattered Laser Rifle (Setup for a tripwire on a side door)
- Whiskey (Beside the cash register)
- Yum Yum Deviled Eggs (Beside the cash register)
- Canned Dog Food x2 (On the store's shelving)
- Fancy Lads Snack Cakes x2 (On the store's shelving)
- Mr. Handy Fuel (Close to the Nuka-Cola Machine)
- Aluminum Can x3

Locations.Title: Atom's Spring
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.

The location is involved in the [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612) main quest [Visions in the Fog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444037), where one must drink from the small waterfall of highly radioactive spring water to receive “Atom’s Gift” and be welcomed by the cult.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Old Pond House
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers

The house is a Trapper Outpost with no specific side quests or main quests connected to it. There is a novice-locked safe and a bed on the second floor, as well as a cooking station outside.

**Notable Loot:**
- Meat Hook (On the kitchen table)
- Dirty Water (On top of the stove in the kitchen)
- Mongrel Meat (Inside the fridge in the kitchen)
- Office Desk Fan (On a desk on the first floor)
- Abraxo Cleaner (On a shelf in the laundry room)
- Bag of Fertilizer (On the floor in the laundry room)

Locations.Title: Northwood Ridge Quarry
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers & Mirelurks.

Killing the penned-in mirelurks at the bottom of the quarry summons a mirelurk queen. A button located in the main structure detonates explosives across the quarry.

A cave entrance near several mirelurk eggs leads to an interior area with a steamer trunk.

**Notable Loot:**
- [The Islander's Almanac](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72715)
- [Northwood Quarry Note 1](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484611)
- [Notthwood Quarry Note 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484612)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357138)
- [Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=357139)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (Next to a gnome on the roof of the main structure)

Locations.Title: Zephyr Ridge Camp
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Trappers and a Yao Guai attacking the camp.**

At the top of the tower, a trapper armed with a Fat Man waits to rain nuclear hellfire on anyone who gets spotted. An industrial steamer trunk can also be found nearby.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[Mini Nuke](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484224)**
- **Fat Man**: Held by a trapper.

Locations.Title: Ruined Radio Tower
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unoccupied.
The tower serves as the lore explanation for why Diamond City Radio can be heard on the island. Unfortunately for whoever set it up, the blood in the tower’s trailer suggests the noise brought them unwanted attention.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Nuka-Cola Quantum](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=117860)
- [Radioman's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484229)
- Sniper Rifle (On top of the radio equipment)
- Military-Grade Circuit Board (On top of the radio equipment)

Locations.Title: Children of Atom Shrine
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Occupied by Feral Ghouls.**

Only appears on the Pip-Boy map as a fast travel point after visiting during the main quest [Visions in the Fog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444037). The security doors inside the shrine cannot be opened until this quest, as the terminal password will not appear scrawled on a nearby locker until then.

**Notable Loot:**
- **[The Sacred Elements](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484223)**
- **[Note from Atom's Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484222)**
- **[Shrine Password](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571994)**
- **[Stealth Boy](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571996)** 
- **[Mother Icon](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571995)**
- **Glowing Blood Pack**: On a cardboard box inside the building.
- **Glowing Fungus x15+**: Available to harvest throughout the shrine.
- **Garden Gnome**: Beside the large outtake pipe along exterior.
- **Toy Rocketship**: On a table along exterior.
- **Gas Canister**: Beside a radioactive barrel along exterior.
- **Oil Canister**: On the ground along exterior.
- **Industrial Oil Cannister**: Beside a radioactive barrel along exterior.
- **Suprathaw Antifreeze**: Beside a radioactive barrel along exterior.

Locations.Title: Waves Crest Orphanage
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls.

A steamer trunk can be found on the second floor.

**Notable Loot:**
- Overdue Book (Baby Stroller by entrance)
- Overdue Book (Under a bed upstairs)
- Vim (Top of the stairs on the floor)
- Giddyup Buttercup (Next to teacher's desk)

Locations.Title: MS Azalea
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers, including their boss Bilge in a raider power armor.

**Notable Loot:**
- [Power Armor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=564832)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=564834)
- [Fusion Core](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437539)
- [Pirate Hat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=593975)
- Vault-Tec Lunchbox (Barge with the basketball hoop)
- Vim Captain's Blend (Shack below the ship’s elevator)
- Vim x2 (Crate beside the Vim Captain's Blend)
- Med-X (On a shelf alongside chemistry-themed junk)
- Buffout (On a shelf on the floor below Bilge)
- Jet (On a barrel on the main deck, beside the Pirate Hat)
- Psycho Jet (Beside the teddy bear wearing the Pirate Hat)

Locations.Title: National Park HQ
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Super Mutants.

This is a super mutant stronghold with no specific side quests or main quests connected to it, aside from being randomly selected for a radiant quest.

**Notable Loot:**
- None

Locations.Title: Southwest Harbor
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Trappers & Turrets.

There are three steamer trunks located in Southwest Harbor. Two are found on a tugboat wrecked along the shore, surrounded by burning fuel. One of these is called Victoria’s Trunk, tied to the side quest [The Price of Memory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516655). The third trunk is located on the second floor of a large building with a “Tours & Gifts” sign and a cooking station inside.  

**Notable Loot:**
- [Victoria's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514329) (during the side quest [The Price of Memory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516655))
- [Storage Drive](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566721) x3 (during the side quest [Data Recovery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516656))
- Sea Captain's Hat (Near Victoria's Trunk during a quest)

Locations.Title: The Commonwealth
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Fast travel to the [Commonwealth](https://fallout4map.com)

Locations.Title: Cliff's Edge Hotel
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Occupied by Feral Ghouls

The hotel has [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544) underneath it, which can be accessed by traversing the hotel to the roof, then heading back down to reach the elevator that leads to the vault.

*There is an easily missed encounter in [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) with [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544)'s modified Miss Nanny, [Pearl](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563647), provided the main quest quest [Walk in the Park](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403117) has been completed and [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544) has not been visited.*

**Notable Loot:**
- [Trapper's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591946)
- [Nuka-Cherry](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591945)

Locations.Title: Vault 118
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
The vault is the home of wealthy pre-War humans who transplanted their brains into robobrains. It is also home to the murder mystery side quests [Brain Dead](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516652) and [Brain Dead Part, Part 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516653).

**Notable Loot:**
- [Request for Detective](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591957)
- [Letter to Ezra](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591956)
- [Vault 118 Overseer's Log](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437545)
- [Vault 118 Overseer's Key](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591958)
- Vault 118 Key
- [Fencebuster](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72692)
- [The Dapper Gent](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=538646) sold by [Pearl](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563647)
- Vault 118 Jumpsuit
- [Pirate Hat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591947)
- Road Goggles (In the museum, inside an Advanced-locked display case)
- [Cat Remains x7](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591959)
- [Plastic Skull x4](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591960)

Locations.Title: Old Longfellow
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Required:** Complete [Walk in the Park](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403117)

**Companion Quest:** [Shipbreaker](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516654)

**Romanceable?** No

**Affinity Interests:**
- Diplomatic or selfish behavior
- Alcohol usage
- Heal Dogmeat
- Accept settlement quests

**Companion Perk:** Hunter's Wisdom — The Damage Resistance and Energy Resistance of animals and sea creatures is reduced by 25%.

Locations.Title: Mishka
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Sold by [Erickson](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563661). Can be assigned to any settlement to guard it.

Locations.Title: Duke
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Sold by [Erickson](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563661). Can be assigned to any settlement to guard it.

Locations.Title: Gracie
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Sold by [Erickson](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563661). Can be assigned to any settlement to guard it.

Locations.Title: Trailer Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found beside a chem box on the second floor of the Trapper Checkpoint located on the road heading northeast from the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361).

Locations.Title: Ship's Safe Combination
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Automatically added to your Pip-Boy when you listen to the [Safe Room Security Tape](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=145071) found on the terminal inside the safe room at the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361) during the main quest [Cleansing the Land](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444040). 

The safe room entrance is in a bedroom, accessed through a hole in the kitchen pantry, and the code you obtain during the quest allows you to use the keypad in the bedroom to enter.

Locations.Title: Victoria's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Received from Jules in [Acadia](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72615) during the early stages of the side quest [The Price of Memory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516655), this key opens a steamer trunk called Victoria's Trunk aboard the wrecked tugboat in [Southwest Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72360). Within the trunk is [Victoria's Note](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514329), advancing the quest.

Locations.Title: Cranberry Island Supplies Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside a footlocker in the bunker at Cranberry Island Bog. Used to open the Cranberry Island Supply Shed.

Locations.Title: Douglas's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in a tub at the top of the lighthouse at [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355). Unlocks a trunk with an expert lock in the water off the pier south of the lighthouse.

Locations.Title: Nuclear Launch Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in a floor safe inside a submerged ship next to the green tugboat at [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356). The safe can only be unlocked with the [Ship's Safe Combination](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=566149), acquired in the [Harbor Grand Hotel](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72361) safe room during the main quest [Cleansing the Land](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444040) if you side against [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612).

Locations.Title: Fringe Cove Dock Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in a steamer trunk within the central warehouse of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356). It is used to unlock a nearby door with a master level lock.

Locations.Title: Worn Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Given by DiMA at the start of the main quest [Reformation](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444044). 

Opens the door at the unmarked [Pump Control](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514247) station southwest of [Echo Lake Lumber](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72346).

Locations.Title: Shrine Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found during the main quest [Visions in the Fog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444037) scrawled on the side of a locker near the  security doors at the [Children of Atom Shrine](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=80462).

Locations.Title: Tanner Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a Glowing One in the basement of [Eagle's Cove Tannery](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72334), the key unlocks the master-locked basement exit door, the interior advance-locked office, and two safes both with expert level locks at the tannery.

Locations.Title: Manager's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on top of the steamer trunk in the western projection tower at [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335). The key unlocks an expert-locked safe in the employee area behind the northern movie screen, as well as a storage room accessed from the east side of the southern movie screen.

Locations.Title: Vault 118 Overseer's Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on the desk in Ezra Parker’s bedroom accessed through the museum in [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544), it opens the door to the overseer’s office within the vault.

Locations.Title: Vault 118 Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
