Found on "Julianna Riggs"' body in [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544), if they are killed. The key is meant to unlock the sliding door to the left when first entering the vault, which leads to an incomplete area of the vault. 

However, the door appears to unlock on its own during the [Brain Dead](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516652) side quest, without the key. There is nothing of meaningful value inside the incomplete area either.

*They key has no other purpose and cannot unlock the overseer’s room or the museum displays.*

Locations.Title: Aldersea Day Spa Key
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on a super mutant patrolling the pool in the basement at the [Aldersea Day Spa](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72332). It opens the expert-locked door on the north side of the spa, but not the safe or secured room inside the spa.

Locations.Title: Fort Hagen Armory Password
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found in a toolbox found under a clogged bridge south of [Eden Meadows Cinemas](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72335). It is used to unlock a master-locked terminal in [Fort Hagen](https://fallout4map.com?locationIds=71930) back in the Commonwealth. 

*The password appearing in this toolbox in the Far Harbor DLC is a known glitch, possibly caused by it being added to the toolbox by mistake during development.*

Locations.Title: Vim (Oversized Bottle)
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on top of the fountain in the lobby of the Corporate Headquarters area inside the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359). This oversized Vim bottle stacks with regular Vim in your inventory. However, if dropped, it will retain its oversized appearance if dropped on the ground, making it a fun settlement display item.

**Be careful not to lose it among regular Vim bottles, and don’t drink it! You'll probably get diabetes!**

Locations.Title: Mother Icon
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found on a table inside the unmarked [Pump Control](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=514247) station southwest of [Echo Lake Lumber](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72346) during the main quest [Reformation](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=444044). 

This is not required for the quest and can be used as decoration at a settlement.

Locations.Title: Cat Remains x7
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found above the fireplace in Juliana Riggs’ room in [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544), the seven vases contain the cremated remains of Riggs’ cats. They are named “Remains of” Missy I, Missy II, Missy IV, Mr. Purrs, Pepper, Pepper II, and Sir Cattington.

*The vases make the perfect addition to any settlement where one wishes to embrace the Eccentric Cat Lady aesthetic.*

Locations.Title: Plastic Skull x4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Found in a display case secured with an Advanced lock in Ezra Parker’s Museum in [Vault 118](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=437544), the skulls are initially labeled simply as skulls. Upon closer inspection, they are revealed to be fake. One of the skulls is only an upper skull. This is the only location in-game where plastic skulls can be found, making them perfect Halloween decorations for any settlement.

*The plaque for the skulls display case reads: “Pygmy skulls from the Abbadoobo tribe from the Congo. Presented to Mr. Ezra Parker in thanks for saving the tribe from a man-eating tiger while on safari.”*

Locations.Title: Industrial-Grade Fuse x4
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found inside the [Wind Farm Maintenance](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72619) building, these fuses are required to restore power to a secured door before it can be opened. Follow the red wire from the door's activation button to a fuse box, which requires four Industrial-Grade Fuses. Fortunately, all four are nearby: one is next to the fuse box, and the other three are on shelving across the hall.

Locations.Title: Hermit Crab
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on the remains of Trenton Bridge west of [Oceanarium](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72333) it appears as a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant van before revealing itself when approached.

Locations.Title: Bilge
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Trapper boss fought at [MS Azalea](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72610) and the target of the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Hull Breach 2](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516664). He can be killed before the quest begins, allowing the quest to be completed automatically once accepted.

Locations.Title: Gibbons Family
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: When the door to the Gibbons family bunker is opened at [Cranberry Island Bog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72607), the four trapped family members, now feral ghouls, will spawn and attack. Patrick Gibbons appears as a glowing ghoul alongside Victoria Gibbons, Steven Gibbons, and Frederick Gibbons.

Locations.Title: Douglas
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found on top of the top of the lighthouse at [Brooke's Head Lighthouse](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72355). Douglas is a trapper boss and is armed with a harpoon gun.

Locations.Title: Grun
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Grun, a Super Mutant Behemoth, is trapped behind large metal doors in the lower levels of the shipping area of the [Vim! Pop Factory](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72359). The doors can be opened using a nearby terminal with Advanced-level encryption.

*This is the super mutant leader that [Erickson](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563661) locked up during his escape from the Vim! Pop Factory.*

Locations.Title: Hermit Crab
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Located north of [Waves Crest Orphanage](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72358), the Hermit Crab appears to be a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant food truck in a parking lot near several stores. It will reveal itself and attack when approached.

Locations.Title: Red Death
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
An all-powerful Mirelurk found on [Red Death Island](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=484221) during the side quest [The Great Hunt](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516670). 

*Its glowing red eyes lured ships to their doom, causing the island’s many wrecks and lost lives.*

Locations.Title: Hermit Crab
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found in the parking lot of [Briney's Bait and Tackle](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72345), it appears as a Lobster Grill Family Restaurant van before revealing itself when approached.

Locations.Title: Fog Crawler
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found at the [Dalton Farm](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72331), the Fog Crawler is the target of the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Blood Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516660), given by Cassie Dalton.

Locations.Title: Fog Crawler
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found patrolling the southern tip of the enclosed area between a [Buried Ship](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591729) and a [Fishing Sailboat](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=591728), southeast of [The Nucleus](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72612).

Locations.Title: Fog Crawler
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found patrolling near the unmarked [steamer trunk](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=570201), southeast of [Fringe Cove Docks](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72356).

Locations.Title: Fog Crawler
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found patrolling near the unmarked [Abandoned Campsite](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571883), [Submerged Shed](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=571884), and [Blighted Van](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=570208) southwest of the [Ruined Church](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72354).

Locations.Title: Longfellow's Cabin Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
Unlocks when [Old Longfellow](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=351101) becomes available as a companion, after escorting you to Acadia during [Walk in the Park](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=403117).

Workbench is in a shed behind the cabin.

Locations.Title: Dalton Farm Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: The workshop becomes usable during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Blood Tide](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516660), given by Cassie Dalton, which requires eliminating the [Fog Crawler](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=592163) occupying [Dalton Farm](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72331).

Locations.Title: National Park Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Unlocked by speaking to Uncle Ken during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [The Hold Out](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516673), given by [Mitch](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563644) inside [The Last Plank](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=563613).

Locations.Title: Echo Lake Lumber Workbench
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown: Found along the outside southeast corner of the main building at Echo Lake Lumber, it can be unlocked during the [Far Harbor](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=72324) side quest [Turn Back the Fog](https://fallout4map.com/far-harbor?locationIds=516675).
